title: The Book of Jeremiah Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Jeremiah — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
verses.decoded: These are the messages from Jeremiah, son of Hilkiah, a priest from Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin.

verses.kjv: To whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to Jeremiah during the thirteenth year that Josiah, son of Amon, was king of Judah.

verses.kjv: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
verses.decoded: God’s message continued through the reign of Jehoiakim, Josiah’s son, until the eleventh year of Zedekiah, also Josiah’s son, up to the time Jerusalem was taken captive in the fifth month.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
verses.decoded: Before I created you in the womb, I knew you; before you were born, I set you apart and appointed you to be a prophet to the nations.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
verses.decoded: I replied, “Oh Lord GOD, I can’t speak well because I am just a young person.”

verses.kjv: But the LORD said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
verses.decoded: But the LORD told me, “Don’t say you are too young. You will go wherever I send you and say whatever I command.”

verses.kjv: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Don’t be afraid of anyone, because I am with you to protect you,” says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
verses.decoded: Then the LORD reached out, touched my mouth, and said, “I have placed my words in your mouth.”

verses.kjv: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.
verses.decoded: Look, today I appoint you over nations and kingdoms to uproot, tear down, destroy, overthrow, build, and plant.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.
verses.decoded: Then the LORD asked me, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I answered, “I see an almond branch.”

verses.kjv: Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
verses.decoded: The LORD said, “You have seen correctly, because I am ready to carry out my word quickly.”

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling pot facing north.”

verses.kjv: Then the LORD said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.decoded: The LORD said, “Disaster will come from the north against everyone living in this land.”

verses.kjv: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the LORD; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.
verses.decoded: I will summon all the kingdoms from the north,” says the LORD. “They will come and set up their thrones at Jerusalem’s gates, around its walls, and against all the cities of Judah.”

verses.kjv: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.
verses.decoded: I will declare my decisions against them because of all their evil deeds; they have abandoned me, burned incense to other gods, and worshiped things made by their own hands.

verses.kjv: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.
verses.decoded: So prepare yourself, stand up, and tell them everything I command you. Don’t be afraid of how they look at you, or I will embarrass you in front of them.

verses.kjv: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
verses.decoded: I have made you today like a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the entire land—against the kings of Judah, its officials, priests, and people.

verses.kjv: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee, saith the LORD, to deliver thee.
verses.decoded: People will fight against you, but they will not defeat you because I am with you, says the LORD, to rescue you.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
verses.decoded: Go and shout to Jerusalem, saying, 'This is what the LORD says: I remember your early devotion, the love you showed when you followed me in the wilderness, a land that was not planted or cultivated.'

verses.kjv: Israel was holiness unto the LORD, and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Israel was dedicated to the LORD, like the first and best of his harvest. Anyone who harms them will be guilty and will face punishment, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Hear ye the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:
verses.decoded: Listen to the LORD’s message, people of Jacob and all the families of Israel:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?
verses.decoded: The LORD says, 'What wrong did your ancestors find in me that made them turn away and follow worthless things, becoming empty and meaningless?'

verses.kjv: Neither said they, Where is the LORD that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?
verses.decoded: They never asked, 'Where is the LORD who brought us out of Egypt, who guided us through the wilderness, a dangerous and barren land where no one lived or traveled?'

verses.kjv: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.
verses.decoded: I brought you into a rich land to enjoy its fruit and goodness, but when you arrived, you polluted my land and made what I gave you detestable.

verses.kjv: The priests said not, Where is the LORD? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.
verses.decoded: The priests didn’t ask, 'Where is the LORD?' Those who taught the law didn’t know me. The leaders sinned against me, and the prophets spoke in the name of Baal, chasing worthless things.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD, and with your children’s children will I plead.
verses.decoded: So I will continue to argue with you, says the LORD, and I will argue even with your grandchildren.

verses.kjv: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.
verses.decoded: Look beyond to the distant islands of Cyprus and send messengers to Kedar; examine carefully and see if anything like this has ever happened.

verses.kjv: Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.
verses.decoded: Has any nation ever abandoned their gods—who are not really gods? But my people have traded their glory for worthless things that bring no benefit.

verses.kjv: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Be shocked, heavens, at this; tremble with fear and become utterly desolate, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
verses.decoded: My people have done two terrible things: they have abandoned me, the source of living water, and dug broken cisterns that cannot hold water.

verses.kjv: Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
verses.decoded: Is Israel a servant or a native slave? Why have they been plundered and destroyed?

verses.kjv: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.
verses.decoded: Young lions have roared and howled at him, destroying his land; his cities lie in ruins, empty and abandoned.

verses.kjv: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.
verses.decoded: The people from Noph and Tahapanes have crushed your pride and honor.

verses.kjv: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?
verses.decoded: Haven't you brought this on yourself by abandoning the LORD your God, who guided you on the right path?

verses.kjv: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?
verses.decoded: So why are you turning to Egypt and drinking from the waters of Sihor? Why are you going to Assyria and drinking from the Euphrates?

verses.kjv: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, and that my fear is not in thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
verses.decoded: Your own sins will punish you, and your turning away will discipline you. Understand and realize how harmful and painful it is that you have abandoned the LORD your God and do not respect me, says the LORD Almighty.

verses.kjv: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.
verses.decoded: Long ago I freed you from slavery and broke your chains, and you promised not to sin; yet you have gone everywhere, on every hill and under every green tree, committing spiritual adultery.

verses.kjv: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
verses.decoded: I planted you like a fine, pure vine. So how did you become a wild, worthless vine to me?

verses.kjv: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.decoded: Even if you wash yourself with lye and use a lot of soap, your guilt is still clear to me, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;
verses.decoded: How can you say, 'I am pure; I have not followed Baal'? Look at your path in the valley and remember what you have done—you are like a swift camel roaming freely.

verses.kjv: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.
verses.decoded: Like a wild donkey accustomed to the desert, who sniffs the wind and goes wherever she wants—who can stop her? Everyone who tries to catch her won’t give up; they will find her when she is ready.

verses.kjv: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.
verses.decoded: Stop wandering barefoot and stop thirsting, but you said, 'There is no hope for me.' No, because you have loved foreigners and will follow them.

verses.kjv: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,
verses.decoded: Just as a thief feels ashamed when caught, so Israel and its leaders—kings, princes, priests, and prophets—are ashamed.

verses.kjv: Saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.
verses.decoded: They say to a wooden idol, 'You are my father,' and to a stone, 'You gave me life.' They have turned their backs on me, not their faces, but when trouble comes, they will cry out, 'Get up and save us!'

verses.kjv: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.
verses.decoded: But where are the gods you made for yourselves? Let them stand up and save you when trouble comes. You have as many gods as you have cities, O Judah.

verses.kjv: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Why do you argue with me? You have all sinned against me, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
verses.decoded: I punished your children, but it was useless—they did not learn. Your own weapons have killed your prophets, like a fierce lion.

verses.kjv: O generation, see ye the word of the LORD. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?
verses.decoded: Listen, people, pay attention to what the LORD says. Have I been like a desert or a dark place to Israel? Then why do my people say, 'We are in control; we will not come back to you anymore'?

verses.kjv: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
verses.decoded: Can a young woman forget her jewelry or a bride forget her wedding clothes? Yet my people have forgotten me for a very long time.

verses.kjv: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.
verses.decoded: Why do you decorate yourself to look for love? Because of this, you have also taught the wicked your ways.

verses.kjv: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.
verses.decoded: The blood of innocent poor people is found on your clothing; I didn’t have to dig to find it—it’s all over you.

verses.kjv: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.
verses.decoded: But you say, 'I am innocent, so God’s anger won’t come against me.' Well, I will argue with you because you claim, 'I have not sinned.'

verses.kjv: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.
verses.decoded: Why do you keep wandering around trying to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt, just as you were ashamed of Assyria.

verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the LORD hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.
verses.decoded: You will leave him with your hands on your head in despair, because the LORD has rejected your trust, and you will not succeed relying on them.

verses.kjv: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man’s, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: People ask, 'If a man divorces his wife and she marries another man, can he take her back?' They say the land would be greatly defiled. But you have been unfaithful to me with many lovers. Still, the LORD says, 'Come back to me.'

verses.kjv: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.
verses.decoded: Look up to the hills and see where you have not been unfaithful. You have waited for them along the roads like a nomad in the desert. You have defiled the land with your sins and evil acts.

verses.kjv: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore’s forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.
verses.decoded: Because of this, the rains have been withheld, and there has been no late rain. You are shameless like a prostitute who refuses to feel guilt.

verses.kjv: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?
verses.decoded: Won't you now call out to me, 'My Father, you are the one who guided me when I was young'?

verses.kjv: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.
verses.decoded: Will God stay angry forever? Will He keep His anger until the end? Look, you have spoken and done as much evil as you could.

verses.kjv: The LORD said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.
verses.decoded: The LORD told me during King Josiah’s reign, 'Have you seen what unfaithful Israel has done? She has gone up to every high hill and under every leafy tree and committed adultery there.'

verses.kjv: And I said after she had done all these things, Turn thou unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
verses.decoded: I said, 'Come back to me,' after she had done all these things, but she did not return. Her unfaithful sister Judah saw this.

verses.kjv: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.
verses.decoded: I saw that because of all the reasons Israel was unfaithful, I divorced her. But her unfaithful sister Judah was not afraid and also committed adultery.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
verses.decoded: Because of her reckless unfaithfulness, she defiled the land and committed adultery with idols made of stone and wood.

verses.kjv: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Even so, her unfaithful sister Judah has not truly turned back to me with all her heart, but only pretended to, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.
verses.decoded: The LORD told me, 'Unfaithful Israel has been more honest about her guilt than unfaithful Judah.'

verses.kjv: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the LORD; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, saith the LORD, and I will not keep anger for ever.
verses.decoded: Go and announce this message to the northern kingdom: 'Return, unfaithful Israel,' says the LORD. 'I will not bring my anger on you, because I am merciful and will not stay angry forever.'

verses.kjv: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against the LORD thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Just admit your sins—that you have rebelled against the LORD your God, and have gone your own way to foreign gods under every leafy tree. You have not obeyed me, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Turn, O backsliding children, saith the LORD; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:
verses.decoded: Come back, you wayward children, says the LORD. I am married to you. I will bring you back—one person from a city, two from a family—and bring you to Zion.

verses.kjv: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.decoded: I will give you leaders who care for you as I do, who will teach you knowledge and understanding.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when ye be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith the LORD, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the LORD: neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit it; neither shall that be done any more.
verses.decoded: When you have grown and prospered in the land, says the LORD, people will no longer talk about the ark of the covenant. They will not think about it, remember it, or go to see it anymore.

verses.kjv: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.
verses.decoded: At that time, Jerusalem will be called the LORD’s throne, and all nations will come there to honor the LORD’s name. They will no longer follow the stubborn desires of their evil hearts.

verses.kjv: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.
verses.decoded: In those days, the people of Judah will join with the people of Israel, and they will return together from the northern lands to the land I gave as an inheritance to your ancestors.

verses.kjv: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.
verses.decoded: But I thought, how can I bring you back as my child and give you a beautiful land, a glorious inheritance among many nations? I said, you will call me ‘My Father’ and will never turn away from me again.

verses.kjv: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Just like a wife who betrays her husband, you, Israel, have been unfaithful to me, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten the LORD their God.
verses.decoded: A cry was heard from the hills—tears and prayers from the people of Israel—because they have turned away from the right path and forgotten the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: Return, ye backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art the LORD our God.
verses.decoded: Come back, you who have turned away, and I will heal your waywardness. Look, we are coming to you because you are the LORD our God.

verses.kjv: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.
verses.decoded: It is useless to look for salvation from the hills or many mountains; true salvation for Israel comes only from the LORD our God.

verses.kjv: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
verses.decoded: Shame has destroyed the hard work of our ancestors since our youth—their flocks, herds, sons, and daughters.

verses.kjv: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.
verses.decoded: We are filled with shame and confusion because we and our ancestors have sinned against the LORD our God from our youth until now, refusing to obey His voice.

verses.kjv: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the LORD, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.
verses.decoded: If you, Israel, will come back to me, says the LORD, return to me; and if you get rid of your sinful practices that I hate, then you will not be uprooted.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt swear, The LORD liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.
verses.decoded: You will swear by the living LORD, who is true, just, and righteous; and the nations will bless themselves by him and take pride in him.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
verses.decoded: The LORD says to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: Prepare your hearts like fertile soil and don’t plant your seeds among thorns.

verses.kjv: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
verses.decoded: Make a sincere change of heart toward the LORD, people of Judah and Jerusalem, or my anger will burn like an unstoppable fire because of your evil actions.

verses.kjv: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.
verses.decoded: Announce in Judah and Jerusalem: Sound the alarm! Call everyone to gather and take refuge in the fortified cities.

verses.kjv: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
verses.decoded: Raise the signal toward Zion; withdraw quickly and don’t delay, because I will bring disaster from the north, a great destruction.

verses.kjv: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
verses.decoded: Like a lion coming from its hiding place, the destroyer of nations is coming; he has set out to make your land desolate, and your cities will be ruined and empty.

verses.kjv: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.
verses.decoded: Put on sackcloth, mourn and cry out, because the LORD’s fierce anger has not turned away from us.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the LORD, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.
verses.decoded: On that day, says the LORD, the king and his officials will lose heart, and the priests and prophets will be shocked and amazed.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.
verses.decoded: Then I said, ‘Ah, Lord GOD! You have truly fooled this people and Jerusalem by promising peace when the sword is actually reaching their very souls.’

verses.kjv: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,
verses.decoded: At that time it will be said to these people and Jerusalem: A dry wind blows from the hills in the wilderness toward my people’s daughter, but it will not bring relief or cleansing.

verses.kjv: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.
verses.decoded: A strong wind will come from those places, and I will pronounce judgment against them now.

verses.kjv: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.
verses.decoded: Look, he will come like clouds, his chariots like a whirlwind; his horses are faster than eagles. Woe to us, because we are ruined!

verses.kjv: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?
verses.decoded: Jerusalem, cleanse your heart from evil so you can be saved. How long will you keep entertaining worthless thoughts?

verses.kjv: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.
verses.decoded: A voice is heard from Dan, announcing trouble from Mount Ephraim.

verses.kjv: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.
verses.decoded: Tell the nations; announce against Jerusalem that watchmen are coming from a distant land, raising their voices against the cities of Judah.

verses.kjv: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: They surround her like guards watching over a field because she has been rebellious against me, declares the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee; this is thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.
verses.decoded: Your own actions and behavior have brought this upon you; this is your sin—it is bitter and reaches deep into your heart.

verses.kjv: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
verses.decoded: Oh, my inner being! I am deeply distressed; my heart is pounding within me; I cannot stay silent because I hear the trumpet’s blast, the alarm of war, O my soul.

verses.kjv: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains in a moment.
verses.decoded: Destruction after destruction is announced because the whole land is ruined; suddenly my homes and shelters are destroyed in an instant.

verses.kjv: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?
verses.decoded: How long will I keep seeing the battle flag and hearing the trumpet’s call?

verses.kjv: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
verses.decoded: My people are foolish; they do not understand me. They are senseless children with no insight—they are skilled at doing evil but don’t know how to do good.

verses.kjv: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.
verses.decoded: I looked at the earth, and it was formless and empty; I looked at the heavens, and they had no light.

verses.kjv: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
verses.decoded: I saw the mountains trembling and all the hills shaking slightly.

verses.kjv: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
verses.decoded: I looked, and there was no one there; even all the birds in the sky had flown away.

verses.kjv: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the LORD, and by his fierce anger.
verses.decoded: I saw that the fertile land had become a desert, and all its cities were destroyed because of the LORD’s presence and his fierce anger.

verses.kjv: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
verses.decoded: The LORD says the entire land will be laid waste, but I will not completely destroy it.

verses.kjv: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
verses.decoded: The earth will mourn and the skies will grow dark because I have declared this, planned it, and will not change my mind or take it back.

verses.kjv: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city shall be forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.
verses.decoded: The entire city will run away at the sound of horsemen and archers; they will hide in bushes and climb rocks. Every city will be deserted with no one living there.

verses.kjv: And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.
verses.decoded: When you are ruined, what will you do? Even if you dress in fine red clothes, wear gold jewelry, and paint your eyes, it will be useless; your lovers will reject you and try to kill you.

verses.kjv: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreadeth her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.
verses.decoded: I heard the cry of a woman in labor, the pain of a mother giving birth to her first child—the voice of Jerusalem mourning, spreading out her hands and saying, "Woe to me now! My soul is exhausted because of those who kill."

verses.kjv: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.
verses.decoded: Go through the streets of Jerusalem and look carefully. Try to find even one person who does what is right and seeks the truth, and I will forgive the city.

verses.kjv: And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.
verses.decoded: Even though they claim, 'The LORD lives,' they are actually lying when they swear.

verses.kjv: O LORD, are not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.
verses.decoded: Lord, aren’t you watching for truth? You have punished them, but they didn’t feel sorry; you have destroyed them, but they refused to change. They have made their faces harder than stone and won’t turn back.

verses.kjv: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the LORD, nor the judgment of their God.
verses.decoded: So I said, These people are hopeless and foolish because they don’t know God’s ways or understand His justice.

verses.kjv: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of the LORD, and the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
verses.decoded: I will go to the leaders and speak to them because they know God’s ways and justice, but the people have completely rejected God’s authority and broken free from His control.

verses.kjv: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.
verses.decoded: So a lion from the forest will kill them, a wolf from the desert will attack them in the evening, and a leopard will watch over their cities. Anyone who leaves will be torn apart because their sins are many and their rebellion has grown.

verses.kjv: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots’ houses.
verses.decoded: How can I forgive you? Your children have abandoned me and sworn by false gods. After I gave them everything they needed, they were unfaithful and gathered together in houses of prostitution.

verses.kjv: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour’s wife.
verses.decoded: They were like well-fed horses in the morning, each one eagerly chasing after his neighbor’s wife.

verses.kjv: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the LORD: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.decoded: Won’t I punish them for these sins? says the LORD. Won’t I take revenge on such a nation?

verses.kjv: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the LORD’s.
verses.decoded: Attack her walls and destroy them, but don’t completely wipe her out. Remove her defenses because they do not belong to the LORD.

verses.kjv: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel and Judah have been very unfaithful to me, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: They have belied the LORD, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
verses.decoded: They have lied about the LORD, saying, 'He is not real; no disaster will come to us, and we won’t face war or famine.'

verses.kjv: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
verses.decoded: The false prophets are like empty wind; their words have no truth. This is what will happen to them.

verses.kjv: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
verses.decoded: Therefore, says the LORD Almighty, because you say these things, I will make my words in your mouth like fire, and this people like wood, and the fire will burn them up.

verses.kjv: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the LORD: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.
verses.decoded: Look, I will bring a nation against you from far away, O Israel, says the LORD. It is a powerful and old nation whose language you do not know and cannot understand.

verses.kjv: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
verses.decoded: Their weapons are like open graves; they are all strong warriors.

verses.kjv: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.
verses.decoded: They will destroy your crops and food meant for your children; they will consume your livestock, vineyards, and fig trees. They will ruin your fortified cities, which you trusted in, by the sword.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless in those days, saith the LORD, I will not make a full end with you.
verses.decoded: But during those days, says the LORD, I will not completely destroy you.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the LORD our God all these things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.
verses.decoded: When you ask, 'Why is the LORD our God doing all these things to us?' you must answer, 'Because you abandoned me and worshiped foreign gods in your own land, so now you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.'

verses.kjv: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
verses.decoded: Announce this to the people of Israel and spread it throughout Judah, saying,

verses.kjv: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
verses.decoded: Listen to this, you foolish people without understanding; you have eyes but do not see, and ears but do not hear.

verses.kjv: Fear ye not me? saith the LORD: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?
verses.decoded: Do you not fear me? says the LORD. Will you not tremble before me, who set the sand as the boundary for the sea, a permanent limit it cannot cross? Though the waves toss and roar, they cannot overcome it.

verses.kjv: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
verses.decoded: But these people have stubborn and rebellious hearts; they have turned away and are gone.

verses.kjv: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
verses.decoded: They do not even think to fear the LORD their God, who gives both the early and late rains in their season and keeps the set times for the harvest.

verses.kjv: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.
verses.decoded: Your sins have caused these blessings to be withheld from you.

verses.kjv: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
verses.decoded: Among my people are wicked men who lie in wait like hunters setting traps to catch others.

verses.kjv: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
verses.decoded: Their houses are full of deceit, like a cage full of birds; because of this, they have become powerful and wealthy.

verses.kjv: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
verses.decoded: They have grown fat and proud; they do more evil than others. They do not defend the cause of the fatherless or judge fairly for the needy, yet they still prosper.

verses.kjv: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.decoded: Will I not punish these things? says the LORD. Will I not take revenge on such a nation as this?

verses.kjv: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
verses.decoded: A shocking and terrible thing has happened in the land.

verses.kjv: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?
verses.decoded: The prophets speak lies, and the priests lead by those lies; my people enjoy it that way. So what will you do when it all comes to an end?

verses.kjv: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Bethhaccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.
verses.decoded: People of Benjamin, get ready to escape from Jerusalem. Sound the alarm in Tekoa and light a signal fire in Bethhaccerem, because danger is coming from the north, bringing great destruction.

verses.kjv: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.
verses.decoded: I have compared Jerusalem (the daughter of Zion) to a beautiful and delicate woman.

verses.kjv: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
verses.decoded: Enemies, like shepherds with their flocks, will surround her and set up camps all around, each taking their place to feed and take what they want.

verses.kjv: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
verses.decoded: Get ready to attack her; rise up and advance at midday. Woe to us! The day is ending and evening shadows are growing long.

verses.kjv: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
verses.decoded: Let’s attack by night and destroy her palaces.

verses.kjv: For thus hath the LORD of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD of hosts says: Cut down trees and build a siege ramp against Jerusalem. This city will be punished because it is full of oppression.

verses.kjv: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.
verses.decoded: Just as a fountain pours out water, Jerusalem pours out wickedness. Violence and robbery are everywhere, causing me constant pain and sorrow.

verses.kjv: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.
verses.decoded: Learn this lesson, Jerusalem, or I will abandon you and make you a deserted land with no people living there.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.
verses.decoded: The LORD of hosts says the enemy will thoroughly gather what is left of Israel, like a grape picker gathering grapes into baskets.

verses.kjv: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the LORD is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
verses.decoded: Who can I speak to and warn so they will listen? Their hearts are closed and they refuse to hear. God’s words are a disgrace to them, and they don’t want to accept them.

verses.kjv: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.
verses.decoded: Because of this, I am filled with the LORD’s anger and can no longer hold it back. I will unleash it on the young and old alike; even husbands and wives, the elderly and those full of years, will be taken away.

verses.kjv: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Their homes, fields, and wives will be given to others, because I will punish the people of the land, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.decoded: From the lowest to the highest, everyone is greedy; even the prophets and priests are dishonest.

verses.kjv: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verses.decoded: They have tried to heal the wounds of my people superficially, saying 'Peace, peace,' when there is actually no peace.

verses.kjv: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Were they ashamed of their sinful actions? No, they felt no shame or embarrassment. Because of this, they will fall with others who fall; when I punish them, they will be brought down, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, Stand at the crossroads, look around, and ask for the ancient paths where the good way is. Walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they replied, 'We will not walk that way.'

verses.kjv: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
verses.decoded: I appointed watchmen to warn you, telling you to listen to the trumpet's sound. But they said, 'We will not listen.'

verses.kjv: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
verses.decoded: So listen, nations, and understand, assembly of peoples, what is happening among them.

verses.kjv: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
verses.decoded: Listen, earth! I will bring disaster on this people as a result of their own plans, because they have not listened to my words or obeyed my law, but have rejected it.

verses.kjv: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
verses.decoded: Why do you bring me incense from Sheba or sweet cane from distant lands? Your burnt offerings and sacrifices are not pleasing to me.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.
verses.decoded: Therefore, the LORD says, I will place obstacles before these people, and both parents and children will fall because of them; neighbors and friends will be destroyed together.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, Look, a people is coming from the north, a great nation rising from the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.
verses.decoded: They will take up bows and spears; they are cruel and show no mercy. Their voices roar like the sea as they ride horses, arranged for battle against you, O daughter of Zion.

verses.kjv: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.decoded: We have heard about it; our strength is gone. Anguish grips us, pain like that of a woman giving birth.

verses.kjv: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.
verses.decoded: Do not go out into the fields or walk on the roads, because the enemy’s sword and fear are everywhere.

verses.kjv: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
verses.decoded: O daughter of my people, put on sackcloth and cover yourself with ashes; mourn as if for an only son, with deep sorrow, because destruction will come suddenly upon us.

verses.kjv: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.
verses.decoded: I have made you like a tower and fortress among my people so you can observe and test their behavior.

verses.kjv: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
verses.decoded: They are all serious rebels, spreading slander; they are hard like brass and iron; they are all corrupt.

verses.kjv: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
verses.decoded: The bellows are burned, the lead melts in the fire; the metalworker works in vain because the wicked are not removed.

verses.kjv: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.
verses.decoded: People will call them worthless silver because the LORD has rejected them.

verses.kjv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.decoded: This message came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

verses.kjv: Stand in the gate of the LORD’s house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.
verses.decoded: Stand at the entrance of the LORD’s temple and announce this message: Listen to the word of the LORD, all of Judah who come through these gates to worship Him.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Change your behavior and actions, and I will let you live safely in this land.

verses.kjv: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, are these.
verses.decoded: Don’t trust false promises by saying, ‘The LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple—this is all we need.’

verses.kjv: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
verses.decoded: But if you sincerely change your ways and actions, and if you judge fairly between people,

verses.kjv: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
verses.decoded: If you do not mistreat foreigners, orphans, and widows, do not kill innocent people here, and do not follow other gods that harm you,

verses.kjv: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: Then I will let you live in this land I gave to your ancestors forever.

verses.kjv: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
verses.decoded: But look, you trust in false words that bring no benefit.

verses.kjv: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;
verses.decoded: Do you steal, kill, commit adultery, lie under oath, worship Baal by burning incense, and follow other gods you don’t even know?

verses.kjv: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
verses.decoded: Then come and stand before me in this temple, which bears my name, and say, ‘We are free to do all these terrible things?’

verses.kjv: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Do you think this temple, which bears my name, has become a hideout for thieves? I have seen it too, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
verses.decoded: Go now to my former sanctuary at Shiloh, where I first placed my name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of my people Israel.

verses.kjv: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;
verses.decoded: Now, because you have done all these things, says the LORD, I have spoken to you repeatedly, but you did not listen; I have called you, but you did not answer.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
verses.decoded: So I will treat this temple, which bears my name and in which you trust, and this land I gave you and your ancestors, the same way I treated Shiloh.

verses.kjv: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
verses.decoded: I will reject you and remove you from my presence, just as I rejected all your relatives—the entire family of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.
verses.decoded: Do not pray for these people, do not cry out or pray for them, and do not plead with me, because I will not listen to you.

verses.kjv: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.decoded: Don’t you see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and on the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.kjv: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
verses.decoded: Children gather wood, fathers light fires, and women prepare dough to make cakes for the 'queen of heaven' and pour out drink offerings to other gods, which angers me.

verses.kjv: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
verses.decoded: Do they really make me angry? declares the LORD. No, they only bring shame and disgrace on themselves.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: My anger and fury will be poured out on this place—on people, animals, trees, and crops—and it will burn without being put out.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Take your burnt offerings and sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves.

verses.kjv: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
verses.decoded: I did not speak to your ancestors or command them about burnt offerings or sacrifices when I brought them out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
verses.decoded: Instead, I commanded them to listen to me, and I would be their God and they would be my people. I told them to follow my ways so things would go well for them.

verses.kjv: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
verses.decoded: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed their own evil plans and stubborn hearts, moving backward instead of forward.

verses.kjv: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:
verses.decoded: From the day your ancestors left Egypt until now, I have sent my servants, the prophets, to you regularly, rising early and sending them out.

verses.kjv: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
verses.decoded: But they did not listen or pay attention; they stubbornly refused and were even worse than their ancestors.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
verses.decoded: So you must say all these things to them, but they will not listen. You will call out to them, but they will not respond.

verses.kjv: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
verses.decoded: Tell them, ‘This is a nation that does not obey the LORD their God or accept correction; truth has disappeared and is no longer spoken by them.’

verses.kjv: Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
verses.decoded: Cut off your hair, Jerusalem, throw it away, and mourn on the high places, because the LORD has rejected and abandoned this angry generation.

verses.kjv: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the LORD: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
verses.decoded: The people of Judah have done evil in my eyes, says the LORD. They have placed their disgusting idols in the temple that bears my name, defiling it.

verses.kjv: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.
verses.decoded: They have built altars at Tophet, located in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their children as sacrifices in the fire. This is something I never commanded or even thought of.

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
verses.decoded: Therefore, the LORD says, a time is coming when this place will no longer be called Tophet or the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter, because many will be buried there until there is no more room.

verses.kjv: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.
verses.decoded: The bodies of these people will become food for the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth, and no one will chase them away.

verses.kjv: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
verses.decoded: I will stop all joyful sounds in the cities of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem—the sounds of celebration, happiness, weddings, and brides—because the land will become empty and ruined.

verses.kjv: At that time, saith the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:
verses.decoded: At that time, says the LORD, they will dig up the bones of the kings of Judah, their officials, the priests, the prophets, and the people of Jerusalem from their graves.

verses.kjv: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
verses.decoded: Their bones will be scattered in front of the sun, moon, and all the stars they loved and served, the gods they followed and worshiped. Their bodies will not be collected or buried but will lie exposed on the ground like refuse.

verses.kjv: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.decoded: Those left from this wicked family, scattered wherever I have sent them, will prefer death over life, says the LORD Almighty.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
verses.decoded: Tell them, this is what the LORD says: If someone falls, won’t they get back up? If they turn away, won’t they return?

verses.kjv: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
verses.decoded: So why has the people of Jerusalem continued to turn away from God? They cling to lies and refuse to repent.

verses.kjv: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
verses.decoded: I listened but heard no honest words; no one admitted their wrongdoing or asked, 'What have I done?' Instead, everyone rushed headlong into sin like a horse charging into battle.

verses.kjv: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Even the stork, turtle-dove, crane, and swallow know the right time to come and go, but my people do not understand the LORD’s laws or judgment.

verses.kjv: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of the LORD is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.
verses.decoded: How can you say, 'We are wise, and we have the LORD’s law with us'? The truth is, it has been made worthless; the writings of the scribes are useless.

verses.kjv: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD; and what wisdom is in them?
verses.decoded: The so-called wise are ashamed and confused because they have rejected the LORD’s word. What real wisdom do they have now?

verses.kjv: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
verses.decoded: Because of this, I will give their wives to others and their land to new owners. Everyone, from the least to the greatest, is greedy; from prophets to priests, all are dishonest.

verses.kjv: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verses.decoded: They have tried to heal my people’s wounds superficially, saying 'Peace, peace,' but there is no real peace.

verses.kjv: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Did they feel shame after doing terrible things? No, they were not ashamed at all and could not even blush. So they will fall with those who fall; when I punish them, they will be brought low, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: I will surely consume them, saith the LORD: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.
verses.decoded: I will completely destroy them, says the LORD. There will be no grapes on the vine, no figs on the fig tree; the leaves will wither, and everything I gave them will be taken away.

verses.kjv: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
verses.decoded: Why are we just sitting here? Let’s gather and go into fortified cities and stay quiet there, because the LORD our God has silenced us and given us bitter poison to drink because we have sinned against Him.

verses.kjv: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!
verses.decoded: We hoped for peace and healing, but instead we found trouble!

verses.kjv: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
verses.decoded: The loud neighing of his horses was heard from Dan; the whole land shook at the sound of their powerful neighs because they have come and destroyed the land and everything in it—the city and all its people.

verses.kjv: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Look, I will send poisonous snakes among you that cannot be controlled or stopped, and they will bite you, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.
verses.decoded: When I try to comfort myself in my sadness, my heart feels weak and faint.

verses.kjv: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not the LORD in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?
verses.decoded: Listen to the cries of my people’s daughter because of those living in a distant land: Isn’t the LORD in Zion? Isn’t her king there? So why have they angered me with their idols and worthless foreign gods?

verses.kjv: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
verses.decoded: The harvest is over, the summer has ended, but we have not been saved.

verses.kjv: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.
verses.decoded: I am deeply hurt because my people’s daughter is hurt; I am dark with grief, and shock has overwhelmed me.

verses.kjv: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
verses.decoded: Is there no healing balm in Gilead? Is there no doctor there? Then why hasn’t my people’s daughter been healed?

verses.kjv: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
verses.decoded: I wish my head were a stream of water and my eyes a fountain of tears so I could weep day and night for the people of my nation who have been killed.

verses.kjv: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
verses.decoded: I wish I had a place to stay in the desert, like a traveler, so I could leave my people and go away from them because they are all unfaithful and full of betrayal.

verses.kjv: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: They twist their words like arrows to tell lies; they are not brave enough to stand for the truth on earth. They keep doing evil and don’t know me, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
verses.decoded: Be careful with everyone around you and don’t trust even your own family, because every brother will betray you and every friend will spread lies.

verses.kjv: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.
verses.decoded: They deceive their neighbors and refuse to tell the truth; they have trained their tongues to lie and work hard at doing evil.

verses.kjv: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Your home is full of deceit, and because of this, they refuse to recognize me, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?
verses.decoded: So says the LORD of Heaven’s Armies: I will test and refine them like metal, because what else can I do for my people?

verses.kjv: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.
verses.decoded: Their words are like arrows that shoot lies; one person speaks kindly to a neighbor but secretly plans harm in their heart.

verses.kjv: Shall I not visit them for these things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.decoded: Won’t I punish them for these sins? says the LORD. Won’t I take revenge on such a nation?

verses.kjv: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.
verses.decoded: I will make the mountains cry and wail, and the wilderness homes will mourn because they are destroyed and no one can travel through them. People can’t even hear the animals; birds and wild beasts have fled and are gone.

verses.kjv: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.
verses.decoded: I will turn Jerusalem into ruins, a place where wild animals live, and I will make the cities of Judah empty and without people.

verses.kjv: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?
verses.decoded: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who has heard from the LORD and can explain why the land is destroyed and burned like a desert where no one can travel?

verses.kjv: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
verses.decoded: The LORD says it is because they have abandoned my law that I gave them, have not listened to me, and have not followed it.

verses.kjv: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:
verses.decoded: Instead, they followed their own stubborn desires and worshiped Baal, as their ancestors taught them to do.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
verses.decoded: So says the LORD of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel: I will make this people suffer bitterly like eating wormwood and drinking poison.

verses.kjv: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.
verses.decoded: I will scatter them among foreign nations they and their ancestors have never known, and I will send destruction after them until they are completely destroyed.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women, that they may come:
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD of hosts says: Think carefully and call for the professional mourners to come; send for the skilled women to come as well.

verses.kjv: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
verses.decoded: Let them hurry and begin a lament for us, so that our eyes overflow with tears and our eyelids stream with water.

verses.kjv: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.
verses.decoded: A cry of sorrow is heard from Zion: 'How have we been ruined! We are deeply ashamed because we abandoned our land and our homes have rejected us.'

verses.kjv: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.
verses.decoded: Listen to the word of the LORD, women; pay attention to what he says, and teach your daughters how to mourn and each woman how to lament with her neighbor.

verses.kjv: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.
verses.decoded: Death has come through our windows and entered our palaces, killing children outside and young men in the streets.

verses.kjv: Speak, Thus saith the LORD, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.
verses.decoded: Say, this is what the LORD says: The bodies of men will lie like refuse in the open fields, like leftover grain after the harvest, and no one will gather them up.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:
verses.decoded: The LORD says: Do not boast about your wisdom, strength, or wealth.

verses.kjv: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Instead, let the one who boasts, boast about understanding and knowing me—the LORD who shows love, justice, and righteousness on earth. I delight in these things, says the LORD.
