verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;
verses.decoded: Look, the time is coming, says the LORD, when I will punish those who are circumcised along with those who are uncircumcised.

verses.kjv: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart.
verses.decoded: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the people of Ammon, Moab, and all those living in remote places in the wilderness—these nations are uncircumcised, and even the people of Israel are uncircumcised in their hearts.

verses.kjv: Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:
verses.decoded: Listen to what the LORD is saying to you, people of Israel:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: Do not follow the ways of the nations, and don’t be afraid of the signs in the sky, because those nations are frightened by them.

verses.kjv: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.
verses.decoded: The traditions of the people are meaningless: someone cuts down a tree from the forest, made by a craftsman using an axe.

verses.kjv: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
verses.decoded: They decorate it with silver and gold and secure it with nails and hammers so it won’t fall over.

verses.kjv: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.
verses.decoded: They stand straight like palm trees but cannot speak; they have to be carried because they cannot move. Don’t be afraid of them—they can’t harm you, nor can they help you.

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O LORD; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.
verses.decoded: There is no one like you, LORD; you are great, and your name is powerful.

verses.kjv: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto thee.
verses.decoded: Who wouldn’t respect you, King of all nations? You are in control, and among all the wise people and kingdoms, no one compares to you.

verses.kjv: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.
verses.decoded: But idols are completely senseless and foolish; the wooden block teaches lies.

verses.kjv: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.
verses.decoded: Silver sheets come from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz—both crafted by skilled workers. Their clothes are blue and purple; all of this is made by clever people.

verses.kjv: But the LORD is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
verses.decoded: But the LORD is the true God, the living God, and eternal King. When he is angry, the earth shakes, and the nations cannot stand his anger.

verses.kjv: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
verses.decoded: Tell them this: The gods who did not create the heavens and the earth will disappear from the earth and under the sky.

verses.kjv: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
verses.decoded: He made the earth by his power, set up the world by his wisdom, and spread out the heavens by his understanding.

verses.kjv: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.decoded: When he speaks, the sound of many waters is heard in the sky; he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth, creates lightning with the rain, and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

verses.kjv: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.decoded: Everyone is foolish in their understanding; every maker of idols is confused by the carved image, because their molten idol is a lie and has no life in it.

verses.kjv: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.decoded: They are meaningless and full of mistakes; when judgment comes, they will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts is his name.
verses.decoded: Jacob's share is different from theirs because he is the Creator of everything; Israel is the chosen instrument of his inheritance. The LORD of hosts is his name.

verses.kjv: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
verses.decoded: Pack up your belongings and leave the land, you who live in the fortress.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: I will throw out the people of the land all at once and trouble them so they will realize it is true.

verses.kjv: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.
verses.decoded: I am deeply hurt and wounded; it is a heavy pain, but I said, ‘This sorrow is real, and I must endure it.’

verses.kjv: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
verses.decoded: My shelter is ruined and all my support is gone; my children have left me and are no more. No one remains to set up my tent or hang my curtains.

verses.kjv: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
verses.decoded: The leaders have become foolish and have not sought the LORD; as a result, they will fail, and all their people will be scattered.

verses.kjv: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, and a den of dragons.
verses.decoded: Listen, the sound of an alarm is coming from the north—a great disturbance to destroy the cities of Judah and turn them into deserted places full of wild creatures.

verses.kjv: O LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
verses.decoded: LORD, I understand that people cannot control their own path; no one can direct their own steps by themselves.

verses.kjv: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.
verses.decoded: LORD, discipline me fairly and not in your anger, so you don’t destroy me completely.

verses.kjv: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
verses.decoded: Pour out your anger on the nations that do not know you and on the families that do not call on your name, because they have destroyed Jacob, devoured him, and left his home in ruins.

verses.kjv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.decoded: This message came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

verses.kjv: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
verses.decoded: Listen to the terms of this covenant, and tell the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem;

verses.kjv: And say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,
verses.decoded: Say to them, 'This is what the LORD God of Israel says: Cursed is the person who does not obey the terms of this covenant,'

verses.kjv: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:
verses.decoded: The covenant I gave your ancestors on the day I brought them out of Egypt, out of the place of slavery, saying, 'Listen to me and obey everything I command you; then you will be my people, and I will be your God.'

verses.kjv: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O LORD.
verses.decoded: I made this promise to your ancestors to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, just as it is now. Then I replied, 'Amen, LORD.'

verses.kjv: Then the LORD said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.
verses.decoded: Then the LORD told me, 'Announce all these words in the towns of Judah and on the streets of Jerusalem: Listen to the terms of this covenant and obey them.'

verses.kjv: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
verses.decoded: I warned your ancestors from the day I brought them out of Egypt until now, repeatedly and urgently saying, 'Listen to me.'

verses.kjv: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do: but they did them not.
verses.decoded: But they did not obey or listen; instead, each followed the stubborn desires of their own evil hearts. So I will bring on them all the punishments of this covenant, which I commanded them to follow but they ignored.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Then the LORD said to me, 'There is a conspiracy among the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem.'

verses.kjv: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
verses.decoded: They have returned to the sins of their ancestors who refused to listen to me. They have followed other gods to worship them. Both Israel and Judah have broken the covenant I made with their ancestors.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.
verses.decoded: So the LORD says, 'I will bring disaster on them that they cannot avoid. Even if they call out to me, I will not listen.'

verses.kjv: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
verses.decoded: Then the towns of Judah and the people of Jerusalem will cry out to the gods they burn incense to, but those gods will not save them in their time of disaster.

verses.kjv: For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.
verses.decoded: You have as many gods as you have cities, Judah, and as many altars in Jerusalem as there are streets. You have set up altars to shameful idols, altars to burn incense to Baal.

verses.kjv: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.
verses.decoded: So do not pray for these people or ask me to help them, because I will not listen when they call out to me in their time of disaster.

verses.kjv: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.
verses.decoded: What place does my beloved have in my house, since she has committed adultery with many and the sacred offerings are no longer respected? You enjoy doing evil.

verses.kjv: The LORD called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.
verses.decoded: The LORD named you a healthy olive tree, beautiful and fruitful. But because of loud chaos, He has set fire to it, and its branches have been broken.

verses.kjv: For the LORD of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.
verses.decoded: The LORD Almighty, who planted you, has declared disaster because of the sins of Israel and Judah. They have brought this on themselves by angering me through worshiping Baal.

verses.kjv: And the LORD hath given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.
verses.decoded: The LORD has made me aware of this, and I understand it; He has shown me what they are doing.

verses.kjv: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
verses.decoded: But I was like a lamb or an ox led to the slaughter; I didn’t realize they were plotting against me, saying, 'Let’s destroy the tree and its fruit, and cut him off from the living so his name is forgotten.'

verses.kjv: But, O LORD of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.
verses.decoded: But LORD Almighty, who judges fairly and examines hearts, show me your justice against them, because I have told you my case.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that thou die not by our hand:
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says about the men of Anathoth who want to kill you, saying, 'Don’t prophesy in the LORD’s name or you’ll die by our hands.'

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
verses.decoded: So says the LORD Almighty: I will punish them. Young men will die by the sword, and their children will die from hunger.

verses.kjv: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.
verses.decoded: There will be no survivors among them because I will bring disaster on the men of Anathoth during the year of punishment.

verses.kjv: Righteous art thou, O LORD, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?
verses.decoded: LORD, you are righteous when I bring my case before you, but I want to question you about your decisions: Why do the wicked succeed? Why do those who act very deceitfully seem so happy?

verses.kjv: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou art near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
verses.decoded: You have planted them and they have taken root; they grow and produce fruit. Yet, you seem close to them in what they say, but far from what they truly feel in their hearts.

verses.kjv: But thou, O LORD, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
verses.decoded: But LORD, you know me; you have seen me and tested my heart toward you. Now, gather the wicked like sheep to be slaughtered and prepare them for the day of judgment.

verses.kjv: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
verses.decoded: How long will the land grieve and the plants in every field dry up because of the wickedness of its people? Animals and birds are dying because they say, 'God will not punish us in the end.'

verses.kjv: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
verses.decoded: If you have struggled against those who run on foot and they have worn you out, how will you compete against horses? And if you were tired in peaceful times when you trusted, how will you manage when facing the raging floodwaters of the Jordan River?

verses.kjv: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.
verses.decoded: Even your own relatives and family have betrayed you; they have gathered many against you. Do not trust them, even if they speak kindly to you.

verses.kjv: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
verses.decoded: I have abandoned my home and left my inheritance behind; I have handed over the one I love dearly into the hands of her enemies.

verses.kjv: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.
verses.decoded: My inheritance feels like a lion in the forest roaring against me; because of this, I have come to hate it.

verses.kjv: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.
verses.decoded: My inheritance is like a speckled bird surrounded by other birds ready to attack; come, all the wild animals, gather to devour it.

verses.kjv: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
verses.decoded: Many leaders have ruined my vineyard; they have trampled on my land and turned my once-desirable place into a wasteland.

verses.kjv: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth it to heart.
verses.decoded: They have left it desolate, and seeing it empty makes me mourn; the whole land is ruined because no one cares.

verses.kjv: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.
verses.decoded: Destroyers have come to all the high places across the wilderness, because the LORD's sword will consume the land from one end to the other; no living creature will be safe.

verses.kjv: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.decoded: They have planted wheat but will harvest thorns; they have worked hard but will gain nothing; they will be ashamed of their wealth because of the LORD’s fierce anger.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says about all my wicked neighbors who threaten the inheritance I gave to my people Israel: I will remove them from their land and separate the people of Judah from among them.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
verses.decoded: After I have removed them, I will have compassion on them and bring them back, each to their own inheritance and land.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.
verses.decoded: If they truly learn to follow my people's ways and swear by my name, 'The LORD lives,' just as they once taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will be established among my people.

verses.kjv: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: But if they refuse to obey, I will completely uproot and destroy that nation, declares the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
verses.decoded: The LORD said to me, 'Go and get a linen belt, tie it around your waist, but do not wash it.'

verses.kjv: So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put it on my loins.
verses.decoded: So I got the belt as the LORD commanded and tied it around my waist.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
verses.decoded: Take the belt you are wearing, get up, go to the Euphrates River, and hide it in a crevice in the rocks.

verses.kjv: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
verses.decoded: So I went and hid the belt by the Euphrates River, just as the LORD had commanded.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
verses.decoded: After many days, the LORD said to me, 'Get up, go to the Euphrates, and get the belt you hid there.'

verses.kjv: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
verses.decoded: So I went to the Euphrates, dug it up, and took the belt out. But it was ruined and useless.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: This is how I will destroy the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
verses.decoded: These wicked people refuse to listen to me; they follow their own stubborn hearts and worship other gods. They will become like this ruined belt—completely useless.

verses.kjv: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
verses.decoded: Just as a belt fits tightly around a man's waist, I made the entire nation of Israel and Judah belong to me, so they would be my people, my name, my praise, and my glory. But they refused to listen.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
verses.decoded: So tell them this message from the LORD God of Israel: 'Every wine jar will be filled with wine.' And they will say to you, 'Don’t we already know that every jar will be filled with wine?'

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
verses.decoded: Then say to them, 'This is what the LORD says: I will fill everyone in this land—kings on David’s throne, priests, prophets, and all people in Jerusalem—with drunkenness.'

verses.kjv: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
verses.decoded: I will cause them to fight against each other—even fathers against their sons. I will not pity, spare, or show mercy; I will destroy them, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.
verses.decoded: Listen carefully and pay attention; don’t be proud, because the LORD has spoken.

verses.kjv: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.
verses.decoded: Honor and praise the LORD your God now, before he brings darkness and your feet slip on the dark mountains. While you search for light, he will turn it into deep shadow and thick darkness.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD’s flock is carried away captive.
verses.decoded: But if you refuse to listen, I will cry in secret because of your pride; my eyes will overflow with tears since the LORD’s people are taken into captivity.

verses.kjv: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.
verses.decoded: Tell the king and queen to humble themselves and take their place; their power and glory will be taken away.

verses.kjv: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
verses.decoded: The southern cities will be sealed shut, no one will open them; all of Judah will be taken captive completely.

verses.kjv: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
verses.decoded: Look up and see the people coming from the north; where is the flock I gave you, your beautiful flock?

verses.kjv: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them to be captains, and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?
verses.decoded: What will you say when God punishes you? You have trained your captors to be your leaders; won’t you feel pain like a woman giving birth?

verses.kjv: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, and thy heels made bare.
verses.decoded: If you ask in your heart, 'Why is this happening to me?' it is because your sins are so great that your shame is exposed and your defenses stripped away.

verses.kjv: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
verses.decoded: Can an Ethiopian change his skin or a leopard its spots? Then maybe you, who are used to doing evil, can learn to do good.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.
verses.decoded: Because of this, I will scatter them like dry chaff blown away by the desert wind.

verses.kjv: This is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the LORD; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
verses.decoded: This is your fate, the punishment I have assigned you, says the LORD, because you have forgotten me and trusted lies.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.
verses.decoded: So I will expose your shame openly for all to see.

verses.kjv: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when shall it once be?
verses.decoded: I have seen your unfaithfulness and your lustful acts, your immoral behavior, and your detestable sins on the hills and in the fields. Woe to you, Jerusalem! Will you never be cleansed? When will that happen?

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.
verses.decoded: This is the message from the LORD that came to Jeremiah about the severe famine.

verses.kjv: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.
verses.decoded: Judah is grieving deeply, and its city gates are lifeless and dark; the people of Jerusalem are crying out in distress.

verses.kjv: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
verses.decoded: The leaders sent their children to fetch water from the wells, but they found none; they came back with empty containers, ashamed and confused, hiding their faces.

verses.kjv: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.
verses.decoded: The land is cracked and dry because no rain has fallen; the farmers are ashamed and hang their heads in sorrow.

verses.kjv: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.
verses.decoded: Even the female deer gave birth in the fields and then left because there was no grass to eat.

verses.kjv: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.
verses.decoded: The wild donkeys stood on the hills, breathing hard like dragons, their eyes failing because there was no grass to eat.

verses.kjv: O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou it for thy name’s sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.
verses.decoded: O LORD, even though our sins accuse us, please act for the sake of your name; we have turned away from you many times and sinned.

verses.kjv: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night?
verses.decoded: O hope of Israel, our savior in times of trouble, why do you seem like a stranger in this land, like a traveler who stops only briefly?

verses.kjv: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O LORD, art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.
verses.decoded: Why do you act like someone stunned, like a warrior who cannot save? Yet you, LORD, are here among us, and we bear your name; do not abandon us.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the LORD doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.
verses.decoded: The LORD says to these people: They love to wander and have not stopped their sinful ways, so I will not accept them. I will now punish them for their sins.

verses.kjv: Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.
verses.decoded: Then the LORD told me, 'Do not pray for these people to be spared.'

verses.kjv: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.
verses.decoded: Even if they fast and cry out, I will not listen; even if they offer sacrifices, I will not accept them. Instead, I will destroy them with war, famine, and disease.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.
verses.decoded: Then I said, 'Ah, Lord GOD! But the prophets tell the people they will not face war or famine; instead, they promise true peace here.'

verses.kjv: Then the LORD said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.
verses.decoded: The LORD told me, 'Those prophets are lying in my name. I did not send or command them. They give you false visions and worthless predictions, deceiving you with their own hearts.'

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.
verses.decoded: So the LORD says about those prophets who claim to speak in my name but I did not send them, and who say there will be no war or famine here: those prophets themselves will be destroyed by war and famine.

verses.kjv: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.
verses.decoded: The people who listen to these false prophets will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem because of famine and war. No one will be there to bury them, their wives, sons, or daughters, because I will bring their sins back upon them.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.
verses.decoded: So tell them this: Let my eyes weep constantly, day and night, without stopping, because the young woman representing my people has been deeply wounded and severely hurt.

verses.kjv: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.
verses.decoded: When I go out into the countryside, I see people killed by the sword; when I enter the city, I see those suffering from hunger. Even the prophets and priests are wandering in foreign lands they do not know.

verses.kjv: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!
verses.decoded: Have you completely rejected Judah? Do you hate Zion? Why have you struck us down with no hope of healing? We hoped for peace but found no good, and when we expected healing, trouble came instead.

verses.kjv: We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.
verses.decoded: We admit, Lord, our sins and the sins of our ancestors, because we have disobeyed you.

verses.kjv: Do not abhor us, for thy name’s sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.
verses.decoded: Please do not reject us, for the sake of your name; do not bring shame to your glorious throne. Remember your promise and do not break your covenant with us.

verses.kjv: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? art not thou he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these things.
verses.decoded: Is there anyone among the worthless idols of other nations who can make it rain or send showers from the sky? Aren't you, Lord our God, the one who does this? So we will wait for you, because you created everything.

verses.kjv: Then said the LORD unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.
verses.decoded: Then the LORD said to me, Even if Moses and Samuel were to plead with me, I would not have mercy on these people. Send them away from my presence and let them leave.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD; Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.
verses.decoded: If they ask you, 'Where should we go?' tell them, 'This is what the LORD says: Those meant to die will die; those meant for the sword will be killed; those meant for famine will starve; and those meant for exile will be taken captive.'

verses.kjv: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.
verses.decoded: I will send four kinds of punishment on them, declares the LORD: the sword to kill, dogs to tear, birds of the sky and wild animals to devour and destroy.

verses.kjv: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: I will scatter them to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, did in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?
verses.decoded: Who will have compassion on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will even stop to ask how you are doing?

verses.kjv: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.
verses.decoded: You have abandoned me, declares the LORD; you have turned away. So I will reach out my hand against you and destroy you. I am tired of showing mercy.

verses.kjv: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.
verses.decoded: I will scatter them like chaff at the city gates; I will take away their children and destroy my people because they refuse to turn from their ways.

verses.kjv: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.
verses.decoded: Widows have become more numerous than the sand by the sea. I have sent a destroyer against the city, striking suddenly at midday, bringing terror to the city.

verses.kjv: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: The woman who gave birth to seven children is weak and dying; she has lost her strength while it is still day. She is ashamed and confused. I will hand over the rest to the sword before their enemies, declares the LORD.

verses.kjv: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them doth curse me.
verses.decoded: Woe to me, mother, for giving birth to a man who causes conflict everywhere! I have not charged interest nor borrowed with interest, yet everyone curses me.

verses.kjv: The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
verses.decoded: The LORD said, It will be well with your survivors; I will make your enemies treat you well during times of trouble and suffering.

verses.kjv: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
verses.decoded: Can iron break iron from the north, or steel break steel?

verses.kjv: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
verses.decoded: I will hand over your wealth and treasures to be plundered without payment, because of all your sins throughout your land.

verses.kjv: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger, which shall burn upon you.
verses.decoded: I will force you to go into exile with your enemies to a land you do not know, because my anger is like a fire burning against you.

verses.kjv: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.
verses.decoded: O LORD, you know everything; please remember me, look after me, and punish those who persecute me. Do not take me away in your patience; know that I have suffered insults because of you.

verses.kjv: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
verses.decoded: I discovered your words and took them in; your message brought joy and gladness to my heart because I am known by your name, LORD God of heavenly armies.

verses.kjv: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.
verses.decoded: I did not join those who mock or celebrate; instead, I sat alone because of your discipline, for you have filled me with anger and frustration.

verses.kjv: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?
verses.decoded: Why does my suffering never end, and why won’t my wound heal? Are you going to be completely untrustworthy to me, like water that dries up?

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, and thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, If you come back to me, I will restore you, and you will stand in my presence. If you separate what is valuable from what is worthless, you will speak for me. Let others come back to you, but don’t go back to them.

verses.kjv: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will make you like a strong bronze wall to protect this people. They will attack you, but they will not defeat you because I am with you to save and rescue you, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
verses.decoded: I will rescue you from the power of the wicked and redeem you from those who are cruel.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD came also unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.
verses.decoded: You must not marry or have children here.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says about the sons and daughters born here, and about their mothers and fathers who live in this land:

verses.kjv: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.decoded: They will die terrible deaths; no one will mourn or bury them. Their bodies will lie on the ground like refuse, eaten by birds and wild animals because of war and famine.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD, even lovingkindness and mercies.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, do not enter a house of mourning or grieve for the dead here, because I have taken away my peace, love, and mercy from these people.

verses.kjv: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:
verses.decoded: Both important and ordinary people will die here; they will not be buried, and no one will mourn by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.

verses.kjv: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
verses.decoded: No one will tear their clothes in mourning or offer a comforting drink for the dead, whether father or mother.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.
verses.decoded: You must not attend any celebrations or feasts to eat and drink with them.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.
verses.decoded: The LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will stop all joy here during your lifetime—the sounds of laughter, happiness, weddings, and celebrations will end.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?
verses.decoded: When you tell the people these things, they will ask, 'Why has the LORD declared such terrible disaster on us? What wrong have we done against the LORD our God?'

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;
verses.decoded: You must answer them, 'Because your ancestors abandoned me,' says the LORD, 'and followed other gods, served and worshiped them, rejected me, and disobeyed my law.'

verses.kjv: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:
verses.decoded: You have done even worse than your ancestors; each of you follows the stubborn desires of your own evil hearts and refuses to listen to me.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.
verses.decoded: So I will drive you out of this land into a place unknown to you and your ancestors, where you will serve other gods day and night, and I will not show you any kindness there.

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be said, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.decoded: But the time is coming, says the LORD, when people will no longer say, 'The LORD lives, who brought Israel out of Egypt.'

verses.kjv: But, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
verses.decoded: Instead, they will say, 'The LORD lives, who brought Israel back from the north and all the lands where he had scattered them.' I will bring them back to the land I gave their ancestors.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
verses.decoded: Look, I will send many fishermen, says the LORD, and they will catch them; then I will send many hunters who will chase them from every mountain, hill, and even from the hiding places in the rocks.

verses.kjv: For mine eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.
verses.decoded: For I am watching all their actions; nothing is hidden from me, and their sins are not concealed from my sight.

verses.kjv: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.
verses.decoded: First, I will punish their sins and wrongdoings twice as much because they have polluted my land and filled my inheritance with the dead bodies of their disgusting and hateful idols.

verses.kjv: O LORD, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.
verses.decoded: O LORD, you are my strength, fortress, and safe place in times of trouble. People from distant nations will come to you and say, 'Our ancestors were deceived by false gods and worthless things that brought no benefit.'

verses.kjv: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?
verses.decoded: Can a person make gods for themselves, and yet those gods are not really gods?

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is The LORD.
verses.decoded: So now, I will make them understand my power and strength, and they will know that my name is the LORD.

verses.kjv: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
verses.decoded: The sin of Judah is deeply engraved, like with an iron pen and a diamond point; it is carved into their hearts and even on the corners of your altars.

verses.kjv: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.
verses.decoded: Their children still remember their altars and sacred groves near the green trees on the high hills.

verses.kjv: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil, and thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.
verses.decoded: My mountain in the open country, I will let your wealth and all your treasures be taken away, and your places of worship for sin will be destroyed throughout your land.

verses.kjv: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.
verses.decoded: You yourself will lose the inheritance I gave you, and I will make you serve your enemies in a foreign land you do not know, because you have angered me, and my anger will burn forever.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the LORD.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: Cursed is the person who trusts in humans and relies on their own strength, whose heart turns away from the LORD.

verses.kjv: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.
verses.decoded: That person will be like a shrub in the desert, not seeing good things come; they will live in dry, empty places where no one lives.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
verses.decoded: Blessed is the person who trusts in the LORD and whose hope is in Him.

verses.kjv: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
verses.decoded: They will be like a tree planted by the water, spreading roots by the river; it won’t fear heat or drought, and it will keep producing fruit.

verses.kjv: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
verses.decoded: The human heart is more deceitful than anything else and is desperately sick—who can truly understand it?

verses.kjv: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
verses.decoded: I, the LORD, examine the heart and test the mind, to reward each person according to their actions and the results of what they do.

verses.kjv: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
verses.decoded: Like a partridge that lays eggs but does not hatch them, a person who gains wealth unfairly will lose it before their time and be considered a fool at the end.

verses.kjv: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.
verses.decoded: The majestic throne has been the place of our sanctuary from the very beginning.

verses.kjv: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the fountain of living waters.
verses.decoded: O LORD, the hope of Israel, everyone who abandons you will be ashamed; those who turn away from me will be forgotten because they have rejected the LORD, the source of life-giving water.

verses.kjv: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
verses.decoded: Heal me, LORD, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, because you are my praise.

verses.kjv: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of the LORD? let it come now.
verses.decoded: Look, they say to me, 'Where is the word of the LORD? Let it come now!'

verses.kjv: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was right before thee.
verses.decoded: As for me, I have not rushed to be a leader following you; I have not wished for a day of disaster. You know that what I have spoken was right in your sight.

verses.kjv: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my hope in the day of evil.
verses.decoded: Do not terrify me, Lord; you are my hope when trouble comes.

verses.kjv: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
verses.decoded: Let those who persecute me be ashamed, but don’t let me be ashamed; let them be terrified, but don’t let me be terrified. Bring disaster on them twice over.

verses.kjv: Thus said the LORD unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.decoded: The LORD said to me, 'Go stand at the city gate where the kings of Judah enter and leave, and at all the gates of Jerusalem.'

verses.kjv: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
verses.decoded: Tell them, 'Listen to the word of the LORD, kings of Judah, all of Judah, and all who live in Jerusalem who enter through these gates.'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.decoded: The LORD says: Be careful not to carry any load on the Sabbath day or bring it into Jerusalem through the gates.

verses.kjv: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
verses.decoded: Do not carry anything out of your homes or do any work on the Sabbath; keep the Sabbath holy as I commanded your ancestors.

verses.kjv: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
verses.decoded: But they did not obey or listen; they made their necks stiff to refuse hearing or accepting correction.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
verses.decoded: The LORD says if you carefully obey me by not bringing any load through the city gates on the Sabbath and by keeping the Sabbath holy without working,

verses.kjv: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.
verses.decoded: Then kings and princes will enter the city gates, sitting on David’s throne, riding in chariots and horses, along with their officials, the people of Judah, and Jerusalem’s residents; and this city will last forever.

verses.kjv: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: People will come from all over Judah, around Jerusalem, from Benjamin, the plains, the hills, and the south, bringing burnt offerings, sacrifices, grain offerings, incense, and praise offerings to the LORD’s temple.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
verses.decoded: But if you refuse to listen and do not keep the Sabbath holy by carrying loads through Jerusalem’s gates on that day, I will start a fire in the gates that will burn down the palaces of Jerusalem and never be put out.

verses.kjv: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.kjv: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
verses.decoded: Get up and go to the potter’s house, where I will show you what I want to say.

verses.kjv: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.
verses.decoded: So I went to the potter’s house and saw him shaping clay on his wheel.

verses.kjv: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
verses.decoded: But the potter’s clay pot was spoiled in his hands, so he reshaped it into a new pot, making it as he wanted.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
verses.decoded: “House of Israel, can’t I do with you what this potter does? You are like clay in my hands, just as the potter shapes the clay, I shape you.”

verses.kjv: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;
verses.decoded: Whenever I say I will destroy a nation or kingdom, uproot and ruin it,

verses.kjv: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.
verses.decoded: If that nation turns away from its evil, I will change my mind and not bring the disaster I planned.

verses.kjv: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;
verses.decoded: And whenever I say I will build up and plant a nation or kingdom,

verses.kjv: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.
verses.decoded: If that nation does evil and refuses to obey me, I will change my mind about the good I planned for them.

verses.kjv: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.
verses.decoded: Now go and tell the people of Judah and Jerusalem, ‘This is what the LORD says: I am planning disaster against you. Turn away from your evil ways and do what is right.’

verses.kjv: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.
verses.decoded: But they replied, ‘There is no hope. We will follow our own plans and do whatever our evil hearts desire.’

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.
verses.decoded: So the LORD says, ‘Ask other nations if they have ever heard anything like this: Israel, my pure and special people, has done something terrible.’

verses.kjv: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?
verses.decoded: Would a person leave the fresh snow on Lebanon’s mountains or abandon the cold streams that flow from the rocks?

verses.kjv: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;
verses.decoded: Because my people have forgotten me, they worship worthless idols and have led themselves away from the old, right paths to follow new, dangerous ways.

verses.kjv: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
verses.decoded: Their land will be left empty and ruined, with people constantly mocking it; everyone who passes by will be shocked and shake their head in disbelief.

verses.kjv: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
verses.decoded: I will scatter them like an east wind blowing them away before their enemies; when disaster strikes, they will run away instead of standing to fight.

verses.kjv: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.
verses.decoded: Then they said, 'Let’s plan against Jeremiah, because the law remains with the priests, advice with the wise, and the prophet’s message is still alive. Let’s attack him with our words and ignore everything he says.'

verses.kjv: Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
verses.decoded: Lord, listen to me and pay attention to those who argue against me.

verses.kjv: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, and to turn away thy wrath from them.
verses.decoded: Is it right to repay good with evil? They have set a trap to kill me, but I stood before you to speak in their favor and to stop your anger against them.

verses.kjv: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.
verses.decoded: So let their children die from hunger, their blood be spilled by the sword; let their wives lose their children and become widows; let their men be killed, and their young men die in battle.

verses.kjv: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.
verses.decoded: Let screams come from their homes when you send soldiers to attack them suddenly, because they have set traps to catch me and hidden snares to trap my feet.

verses.kjv: Yet, LORD, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger.
verses.decoded: But Lord, you know all the plans they have made to kill me; do not forgive their sins or erase their guilt. Let them be defeated in your presence; punish them when you are angry.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Go and get a potter’s earthen bottle, and take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;
verses.decoded: The LORD says, Go and get a clay jar made by a potter, and take some of the elders of the people and some of the elders of the priests with you.

verses.kjv: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,
verses.decoded: Go to the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, near the entrance of the East Gate, and proclaim there the words I will give you.

verses.kjv: And say, Hear ye the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.
verses.decoded: Say, Listen to the word of the LORD, kings of Judah and people of Jerusalem: The LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says, I will bring disaster on this place that will make anyone who hears about it shudder.

verses.kjv: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;
verses.decoded: Because they have abandoned me and made this place unclean by burning incense to other gods that neither they nor their ancestors nor the kings of Judah ever knew, and have filled this place with innocent blood;

verses.kjv: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:
verses.decoded: They have built altars to Baal and burned their sons as offerings to Baal, something I never commanded or even thought of.

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.
verses.decoded: Therefore, the LORD says, the time will come when this place will no longer be called Tophet or the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.

verses.kjv: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.decoded: I will make the plans of Judah and Jerusalem useless here; I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies and those who want to kill them. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth.

verses.kjv: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.
verses.decoded: I will make this city a ruin and a place people will mock; everyone who passes by will be shocked and whistle in disbelief at all the disasters that have come upon it.

verses.kjv: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.
verses.decoded: I will make them eat the flesh of their own sons and daughters, and everyone will eat the flesh of their friends during the siege and desperate times when their enemies and those hunting them close in.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,
verses.decoded: Then you will break the clay jar in front of the people who are with you,

verses.kjv: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter’s vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.
verses.decoded: And say to them, This is what the LORD Almighty says: I will break this people and this city just like a potter breaks a clay jar that cannot be repaired. They will bury their dead in Tophet until there is no more room to bury anyone.

verses.kjv: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD, and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:
verses.decoded: This is what I will do to this place, says the LORD, to its people, and I will make this city like Tophet.

verses.kjv: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.
verses.decoded: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be defiled like Tophet because they have burned incense on their roofs to the starry hosts and poured out drink offerings to other gods.

verses.kjv: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD’s house; and said to all the people,
verses.decoded: After Jeremiah came back from Tophet, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, he stood in the courtyard of the LORD’s temple and spoke to all the people,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.
verses.decoded: The LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will bring all the disasters I have warned about on this city and all its towns because they have stubbornly refused to listen to my words.

verses.kjv: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the LORD, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
verses.decoded: Pashur, son of Immer, a priest and the chief officer in the house of the LORD, heard that Jeremiah was delivering these prophecies.

verses.kjv: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Then Pashur struck Jeremiah and put him in the stocks at the Benjamin Gate near the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The LORD hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magormissabib.
verses.decoded: The next day, Pashur released Jeremiah from the stocks. Jeremiah said to him, 'The LORD has not named you Pashur, but Magormissabib, which means Terror on Every Side.'

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, 'I will make you a source of fear to yourself and your friends. They will be killed by their enemies' swords, and you will see it happen. I will hand over all Judah to the king of Babylon, who will take them captive and kill many.'

verses.kjv: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.
verses.decoded: I will also hand over the city's defenses, all its work, valuables, and the treasures of Judah’s kings to their enemies, who will loot them and take them to Babylon.

verses.kjv: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.
verses.decoded: You, Pashur, and everyone in your household will be taken captive. You will go to Babylon, where you will die and be buried, along with all your friends to whom you have spoken false prophecies.

verses.kjv: O LORD, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.
verses.decoded: O LORD, you have tricked me, and I was fooled. You are stronger than I am and have won. I am mocked every day; everyone ridicules me.

verses.kjv: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the LORD was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.
verses.decoded: Ever since I spoke, I have shouted warnings of violence and destruction, but the LORD’s message has become a constant source of shame and mockery for me.

verses.kjv: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.
verses.decoded: I said, 'I will stop mentioning the LORD and no longer speak in His name.' But His word burned like fire inside me, like a fire locked in my bones. I was worn out trying to hold it in, and I couldn’t.

verses.kjv: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.
verses.decoded: I heard many people slandering me, fear all around. They said, 'Let’s spread rumors.' Everyone who was supposed to be my friend watched for me to slip up, saying, 'Maybe he will be tempted, and then we can defeat him and get revenge.'

verses.kjv: But the LORD is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.
verses.decoded: But the LORD is with me like a powerful warrior. So my enemies will stumble and fail; they will be deeply ashamed and will never succeed. Their disgrace will be remembered forever.

verses.kjv: But, O LORD of hosts, that triest the righteous, and seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.
verses.decoded: O LORD of Heaven’s armies, who tests the righteous and knows the thoughts and intentions of the heart, show me your justice against my enemies, because I have brought my case before you.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD, praise ye the LORD: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
verses.decoded: Sing to the LORD, praise the LORD, for he has saved the life of the poor from the hands of the wicked.

verses.kjv: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
verses.decoded: May the day I was born be cursed; may the day my mother gave birth to me not be blessed.

verses.kjv: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.
verses.decoded: Cursed be the man who told my father, 'A son has been born to you,' and made him very happy.

verses.kjv: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;
verses.decoded: May that man be like the cities the LORD destroyed and never regretted it; may he hear the morning cries and the midday shouting.

verses.kjv: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me.
verses.decoded: Why wasn’t I killed before I was born? Why didn’t my mother’s womb become my grave, so that she never gave birth to me?

verses.kjv: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
verses.decoded: Why was I born only to experience trouble and sorrow, to live a life filled with shame?

verses.kjv: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
