verses.decoded: The LORD gave Jeremiah a message when King Zedekiah sent Pashur, son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah, son of Maaseiah the priest, to him, saying,

verses.kjv: Enquire, I pray thee, of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.
verses.decoded: Please ask the LORD for us, because King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon is attacking us. Maybe the LORD will do something amazing and stop him from coming against us.

verses.kjv: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:
verses.decoded: Jeremiah replied to them, 'Tell King Zedekiah this:'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD God of Israel says: I will take the weapons you are using to fight the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who are attacking you outside the city walls, and I will bring those weapons into the middle of this city.

verses.kjv: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
verses.decoded: I will personally fight against you with power and anger, with fierce fury and great wrath.

verses.kjv: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.
verses.decoded: I will strike the people and animals in this city; many will die from a deadly plague.

verses.kjv: And afterward, saith the LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
verses.decoded: After that, the LORD says, I will hand over King Zedekiah, his officials, the people, and anyone left in this city who survived the plague, sword, and famine, into the hands of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, their enemies, and those who want to kill them. Nebuchadnezzar will kill them with the sword and will not spare or show mercy.

verses.kjv: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.
verses.decoded: Tell the people, 'This is what the LORD says: I have set before you two choices—life or death.'

verses.kjv: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.
verses.decoded: Anyone who stays inside this city will die by the sword, famine, or plague; but anyone who leaves and surrenders to the Babylonians surrounding you will live, and their life will be their reward.

verses.kjv: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the LORD: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
verses.decoded: I have decided to bring disaster on this city, not good, says the LORD. It will be handed over to the king of Babylon, who will burn it down.

verses.kjv: And touching the house of the king of Judah, say, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
verses.decoded: And about the royal family of Judah, say: Listen to the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv: O house of David, thus saith the LORD; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
verses.decoded: House of David, this is what the LORD says: Act justly early and rescue those taken by oppressors, or my anger will flare up like a fire that no one can put out because of your evil actions.

verses.kjv: Behold, I am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, and rock of the plain, saith the LORD; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?
verses.decoded: Look, I am against you, people living in the valley and on the rocky plain, says the LORD—those who say, 'Who will attack us? Who will enter our homes?'

verses.kjv: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the LORD: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.
verses.decoded: But I will punish you based on what you have done, says the LORD. I will start a fire in your forests that will destroy everything around it.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: Go to the palace of the king of Judah and deliver this message there.

verses.kjv: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:
verses.decoded: Say, 'Listen to the word of the LORD, king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne, along with your officials and all the people who come through these gates.'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: Act justly and do what is right. Rescue those being robbed by oppressors. Don’t mistreat or harm foreigners, orphans, or widows. Don’t shed innocent blood in this place.

verses.kjv: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.
verses.decoded: If you truly do these things, then kings will continue to enter through the gates of this palace, sitting on David’s throne, riding in chariots and on horses, along with their officials and people.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.
verses.decoded: But if you refuse to listen to these words, I swear by myself, declares the LORD, this palace will become a ruin.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD unto the king’s house of Judah; Thou art Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make thee a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says to the royal family of Judah: You are like Gilead to me, and like the summit of Lebanon; yet I will turn you into a wasteland and empty cities.

verses.kjv: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.
verses.decoded: I will send destroyers against you, each armed with weapons. They will cut down your finest cedars and burn them.

verses.kjv: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this great city?
verses.decoded: Many nations will pass by this city and ask each other, 'Why has the LORD done this to this great city?'

verses.kjv: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.
verses.decoded: The answer will be, 'Because they abandoned the LORD’s covenant and worshiped and served other gods.'

verses.kjv: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.
verses.decoded: Don’t weep for the dead or mourn them; instead, mourn deeply for the one who is leaving, because they will never return or see their homeland again.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says about Shallum son of Josiah, king of Judah, who ruled instead of his father Josiah and left this place: He will never return here again.

verses.kjv: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.
verses.decoded: He will die in the place where his captors take him and will never see this land again.

verses.kjv: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour’s service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;
verses.decoded: Woe to the one who builds his house through injustice and his rooms through wrongdoing; who exploits his neighbor’s labor without paying for it.

verses.kjv: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
verses.decoded: Who says, ‘I will build myself a spacious house with many rooms, with windows carved out, cedar paneling, and painted red.’

verses.kjv: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest thyself in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?
verses.decoded: Will you reign just because you live in cedar-paneled houses? Didn’t your father eat and drink but also practice justice and righteousness, and things went well for him?

verses.kjv: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well with him: was not this to know me? saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: He defended the rights of the poor and needy; then things went well for him. Didn't he know that this was to recognize me? says the LORD.

verses.kjv: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.
verses.decoded: But your eyes and heart are only set on greed, on shedding innocent blood, on oppression, and on violence to carry it out.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says about Jehoiakim, son of Josiah, king of Judah: No one will mourn for him, saying, 'Oh my brother!' or 'Oh my sister!' No one will mourn for him, saying, 'Oh lord!' or 'Oh his honor!'

verses.kjv: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He will be buried like a donkey—dragged out and thrown beyond Jerusalem’s gates.

verses.kjv: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.
verses.decoded: Go up to Lebanon and shout; raise your voice in Bashan and shout from the mountain passes, because all your friends are destroyed.

verses.kjv: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; but thou saidst, I will not hear. This hath been thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.
verses.decoded: I spoke to you when you were prosperous, but you said, 'I will not listen.' This has been your attitude since youth—you have not obeyed my voice.

verses.kjv: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.
verses.decoded: The wind will sweep away all your leaders, and your allies will be taken captive. Then you will be ashamed and humiliated for all your evil deeds.

verses.kjv: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!
verses.decoded: O resident of Lebanon who makes your home among the cedars, how will you endure when you experience the pain of childbirth?

verses.kjv: As I live, saith the LORD, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;
verses.decoded: As surely as I live, says the LORD, even if Coniah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, were like a signet ring on my right hand, I would still remove you from there.

verses.kjv: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.decoded: I will hand you over to those who want to kill you, to those you fear—the king of Babylon, Nebuchadnezzar, and the Babylonians.

verses.kjv: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.
verses.decoded: I will exile you and your mother to a foreign land where you were not born, and there you will die.

verses.kjv: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.
verses.decoded: But the land they long to return to, they will not go back there.

verses.kjv: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?
verses.decoded: Is Coniah a rejected, broken idol? Is he a useless vessel? Why then are he and his descendants exiled to a land they do not know?

verses.kjv: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Earth, earth, earth, listen to the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, Write ye this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: Record this man as childless, a man who will not succeed. None of his descendants will prosper by sitting on David’s throne or ruling in Judah again.

verses.kjv: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Terrible judgment is coming on the leaders who harm and scatter my people, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD God of Israel says about the leaders who are supposed to care for my people: You have scattered my flock, driven them away, and neglected them. I will punish you for what you have done, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
verses.decoded: I will gather the remaining people I have scattered across all nations and bring them back to their homes, where they will thrive and multiply.

verses.kjv: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will appoint good leaders to care for them. They will no longer be afraid, discouraged, or in need, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
verses.decoded: Look, the time is coming, says the LORD, when I will raise up a righteous descendant of David. A King will rule successfully and bring justice to the earth.

verses.kjv: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.
verses.decoded: During his reign, Judah will be saved and Israel will live in safety. He will be called ‘The LORD Our Righteousness.’

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
verses.decoded: So, the time is coming, says the LORD, when people will no longer say, ‘The LORD lives, who brought Israel out of Egypt.’

verses.kjv: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
verses.decoded: Instead, they will say, ‘The LORD lives, who brought Israel back from the north and all the countries where I had scattered them. They will live safely in their own land.’

verses.kjv: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.
verses.decoded: My heart is broken because of the prophets; my whole body trembles. I feel like a drunkard overcome by wine because of the LORD and His holy words.

verses.kjv: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.
verses.decoded: The land is full of unfaithful people; because of their false oaths, the land mourns. The beautiful wilderness is dried up, violence is everywhere, and justice is lacking.

verses.kjv: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Both prophets and priests are corrupt; I have found their wickedness even in my own temple, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Their path will be like a slippery slope in darkness; they will be pushed and will fall. I will bring disaster on them during the year I punish them, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
verses.decoded: I have seen foolishness in the prophets of Samaria; they worshiped Baal and led my people Israel astray.

verses.kjv: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
verses.decoded: I have seen something terrible in Jerusalem’s prophets: they are unfaithful and deceitful. They encourage evildoers so no one turns from sin. To me, they are like Sodom and its people like Gomorrah.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD of hosts says about the prophets: I will give them bitter poison to eat and make them drink bitter water, because their corruption has spread throughout the land.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD Almighty says: Do not listen to the messages from the prophets who speak to you. They give you empty hopes; they speak from their own imagination, not from what I have said.

verses.kjv: They say still unto them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
verses.decoded: They keep telling those who reject me, 'The LORD says you will have peace.' They also tell everyone who follows their own stubborn desires, 'Nothing bad will happen to you.'

verses.kjv: For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard it?
verses.decoded: Who has been part of the LORD’s inner circle, listening carefully to His plans and hearing His words? Who has truly paid attention to what He says?

verses.kjv: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
verses.decoded: Look, the LORD has sent a powerful storm of judgment, a fierce whirlwind that will strike the wicked hard.

verses.kjv: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.
verses.decoded: The LORD’s anger will not stop until He has carried out His plans and fulfilled what He intends. In the future, you will understand this clearly.

verses.kjv: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.decoded: I did not send these prophets, but they rushed to speak anyway. I did not give them any message, yet they prophesied.

verses.kjv: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
verses.decoded: If they had been part of my plans and made my people listen to my words, they would have turned them away from their evil actions and sinful behavior.

verses.kjv: Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
verses.decoded: Am I only a God who is near, says the LORD, or am I not also a God who is far away?

verses.kjv: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Can anyone hide in secret places where I cannot see them? says the LORD. Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?

verses.kjv: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
verses.decoded: I have heard the prophets who lie in my name, saying, 'I had a dream, I had a dream.'

verses.kjv: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
verses.decoded: How long will these prophets keep lying in their hearts? They are prophets who deceive themselves.

verses.kjv: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
verses.decoded: They try to make my people forget my name by telling their dreams to everyone, just like their ancestors forgot me and worshiped Baal.

verses.kjv: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Let the prophet who has a dream tell it, and let the one who has my word speak it faithfully. What does chaff have to do with wheat? says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
verses.decoded: Is my word not like a fire, says the LORD, or like a hammer that breaks rocks into pieces?

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
verses.decoded: So now, I am against the prophets who steal words from each other instead of speaking my message, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
verses.decoded: Look, I am against the prophets who use their words to claim, 'This is what the Lord says,'

verses.kjv: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: I am against those who claim to speak false dreams and tell lies, misleading my people with their careless words. I did not send or command them, so they will bring no benefit to the people at all, says the Lord.

verses.kjv: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What is the burden of the LORD? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: If the people, a prophet, or a priest asks you, 'What message has the Lord given?' you must answer, 'What message? I will abandon you,' says the Lord.

verses.kjv: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.
verses.decoded: As for any prophet, priest, or person who says, 'This is the Lord’s message,' I will punish that person and their entire family.

verses.kjv: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.decoded: You will all ask each other, 'What answer did the Lord give? What did the Lord say?'

verses.kjv: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man’s word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.
verses.decoded: Do not mention the Lord’s message anymore, because each person will be responsible for their own words. You have twisted the words of the living God, the Lord of Heaven’s armies.

verses.kjv: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.decoded: Tell the prophet, 'What answer did the Lord give you? What did the Lord say?'

verses.kjv: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD; therefore thus saith the LORD; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD;
verses.decoded: But since you keep saying, 'This is the Lord’s message,' the Lord says: Because you say this phrase, 'The Lord’s message,' even though I told you not to say it,

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:
verses.decoded: I will completely forget you, abandon you, and reject the city I gave you and your ancestors, driving you away from my presence.

verses.kjv: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
verses.decoded: I will bring lasting disgrace and eternal shame on you that will never be forgotten.

verses.kjv: The LORD shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the LORD, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
verses.decoded: The LORD showed me two baskets of figs placed in front of the LORD's temple, after King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon had taken captive Jeconiah, son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, along with the leaders, carpenters, and metalworkers from Jerusalem, and brought them to Babylon.

verses.kjv: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
verses.decoded: One basket held very good figs, like the first ripe figs, while the other basket had very bad figs that were so rotten they couldn't be eaten.

verses.kjv: Then said the LORD unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.decoded: The LORD asked me, 'What do you see, Jeremiah?' I answered, 'Figs—some very good, and others very bad, so bad they can't be eaten.'

verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.
verses.decoded: The LORD, the God of Israel, says: Just like these good figs, I will regard the people from Judah who were taken captive to the land of the Chaldeans as good.

verses.kjv: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
verses.decoded: I will watch over them for their good, bring them back to this land, build them up instead of tearing them down, and plant them instead of uprooting them.

verses.kjv: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am the LORD: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.
verses.decoded: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the LORD. They will be my people, and I will be their God, because they will return to me completely.

verses.kjv: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the LORD, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:
verses.decoded: But just like the bad figs that can't be eaten because they're so rotten, this is what the LORD says: I will give King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, the rest of Jerusalem who remain in the land, and those living in Egypt, over to destruction.

verses.kjv: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
verses.decoded: I will hand them over to be scattered among all the kingdoms of the earth as a punishment, making them a disgrace, a proverb, a taunt, and a curse wherever I send them.

verses.kjv: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.
verses.decoded: I will send sword, famine, and disease among them until they are completely destroyed from the land I gave to them and their ancestors.

verses.kjv: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
verses.decoded: This message came to Jeremiah about all the people of Judah during the fourth year of King Jehoiakim, son of Josiah, which was also the first year of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.decoded: Jeremiah the prophet spoke these words to all the people of Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem, saying,

verses.kjv: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of the LORD hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.
verses.decoded: From the thirteenth year of King Josiah, son of Amon, until now—the twenty-third year—the LORD’s message has come to me, and I have spoken to you early and often, but you have not listened.

verses.kjv: And the LORD hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
verses.decoded: The LORD sent all his prophets to you, sending them early and often, but you did not listen or pay attention.

verses.kjv: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
verses.decoded: They said, ‘Each of you, turn away from your evil ways and bad actions, and live in the land the LORD gave to you and your ancestors forever.’

verses.kjv: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
verses.decoded: Do not follow other gods to serve or worship them, and don’t make me angry by what you do; if you don’t, I will not harm you.

verses.kjv: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the LORD; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
verses.decoded: But you have not listened to me,” says the LORD, “and you have made me angry by your actions, which will bring harm to yourselves.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,
verses.decoded: So the LORD of Heaven’s Armies says: Because you have not listened to my words,

verses.kjv: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the LORD, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.
verses.decoded: Look, I will send for all the peoples from the north,” says the LORD, “and I will bring Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, my servant, against this land and its people, and against all these surrounding nations. I will completely destroy them and make them a horror, a curse, and a lasting ruin.

verses.kjv: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.
verses.decoded: I will remove from them the sounds of joy and celebration—the voices of happiness, the bridegroom and bride, the grinding of grain, and the light of the lamp.

verses.kjv: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.decoded: This entire land will become a ruin and a horror, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the LORD, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.
verses.decoded: When the seventy years are finished, I will punish the king of Babylon and his nation,” says the LORD, “for their sins, and I will make the land of the Chaldeans a permanent ruin.

verses.kjv: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
verses.decoded: I will bring upon that land all the things I have spoken against it—all that is written in this book where Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

verses.kjv: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.
verses.decoded: Many nations and powerful kings will take advantage of them, but I will repay them according to what they have done and the results of their actions.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
verses.decoded: The LORD God of Israel said to me, ‘Take this cup of my anger from my hand and make all the nations I send you to drink from it.’

verses.kjv: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
verses.decoded: They will drink deeply, become dizzy, and act crazily because of the destruction I will bring upon them.

verses.kjv: Then took I the cup at the LORD’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the LORD had sent me:
verses.decoded: Then I took the cup from the LORD’s hand and made all the nations He sent me to drink from it.

verses.kjv: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;
verses.decoded: This includes Jerusalem, the cities of Judah, their kings and leaders, to make them a ruin, a shock, a subject of ridicule, and a curse, just as they are now.

verses.kjv: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
verses.decoded: Pharaoh, king of Egypt, along with his officials, princes, and all his people;

verses.kjv: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
verses.decoded: All the mixed peoples, all the kings of Uz, the kings of the Philistine lands, including Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remaining people of Ashdod,

verses.kjv: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,
verses.decoded: Edom, Moab, and the people of Ammon,

verses.kjv: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,
verses.decoded: All the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the islands beyond the sea,

verses.kjv: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,
verses.decoded: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all those living in the farthest places,

verses.kjv: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
verses.decoded: All the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the mixed peoples living in the desert,

verses.kjv: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
verses.decoded: All the kings of Zimri, Elam, and the Medes,

verses.kjv: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
verses.decoded: All the kings of the north, both near and far, together, and all the kingdoms of the world on the earth; and the king of Sheshach will drink after them.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
verses.decoded: So tell them, ‘This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Drink, get drunk, vomit, fall down, and never get up again because of the sword I am sending among you.’

verses.kjv: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.
verses.decoded: If they refuse to take the cup from your hand to drink, then say to them, ‘This is what the LORD Almighty says: You will certainly drink it anyway.’

verses.kjv: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.decoded: Look, I am starting to bring disaster on the city named after me. Should you go unpunished? No, you will not escape punishment. I will call for a sword against all the people on earth, says the LORD Almighty.

verses.kjv: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.decoded: So prophesy these words against them and say: The LORD will roar from heaven and shout from his holy place. He will roar loudly over his home like someone treading grapes, shouting against all the people on earth.

verses.kjv: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: A loud noise will be heard all over the earth because the LORD has a dispute with the nations. He will judge all people and hand over the wicked to be killed, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.decoded: The LORD Almighty says: Look, disaster will spread from one nation to another, like a powerful storm rising from the edges of the earth.

verses.kjv: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
verses.decoded: On that day, those killed by the LORD’s judgment will lie dead from one end of the earth to the other. No one will mourn for them, collect their bodies, or bury them; their corpses will become like manure on the ground.

verses.kjv: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
verses.decoded: Shepherds, cry out in grief and roll in the ashes, leaders of the flock! Your days of being killed and scattered are over, and you will fall like a valuable jar broken to pieces.

verses.kjv: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
verses.decoded: The leaders will have nowhere to run, and the heads of the flock will not be able to escape.

verses.kjv: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture.
verses.decoded: You will hear the shepherds crying out and the leaders wailing because the LORD has destroyed their land and resources.

verses.kjv: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.decoded: The peaceful homes are destroyed because of the LORD’s intense anger.

verses.kjv: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
verses.decoded: He has left his shelter like a lion leaving its den, because their land is ruined due to the harshness of the enemy and God’s fierce anger.

verses.kjv: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the LORD, saying,
verses.decoded: At the start of King Jehoiakim's rule, who was Josiah's son and king of Judah, the LORD gave this message.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Stand in the court of the LORD’s house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD’s house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:
verses.decoded: The LORD says: Stand in the temple courtyard and speak to all the cities of Judah whose people come to worship at the temple. Say everything I command you; do not leave anything out.

verses.kjv: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
verses.decoded: Maybe they will listen, each person turning away from their evil ways, so that I might change my mind about the disaster I planned because of their sins.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,
verses.decoded: Tell them, ‘This is what the LORD says: If you refuse to listen to me and follow the law I have given you,

verses.kjv: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but ye have not hearkened;
verses.decoded: If you do not listen to the words of my servants, the prophets, whom I sent to you repeatedly, but you have ignored them,

verses.kjv: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
verses.decoded: Then I will destroy this temple like Shiloh, and I will make this city a curse among all the nations on earth.

verses.kjv: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: The priests, prophets, and all the people heard Jeremiah say these words in the temple.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.
verses.decoded: After Jeremiah finished speaking everything the LORD commanded, the priests, prophets, and people seized him and said, ‘You must die!’

verses.kjv: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
verses.decoded: They asked, ‘Why have you prophesied in the LORD’s name that this temple will be destroyed like Shiloh and that this city will be deserted?’ Everyone gathered against Jeremiah in the temple.

verses.kjv: When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king’s house unto the house of the LORD, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the LORD’s house.
verses.decoded: When the leaders of Judah heard this, they came from the king’s palace to the temple and sat down at the entrance of the LORD’s temple’s new gate.

verses.kjv: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.
verses.decoded: The priests and prophets told the leaders and the people, ‘This man deserves to die because he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard.’

verses.kjv: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.
verses.decoded: Jeremiah said to the leaders and the people, ‘The LORD sent me to speak all these words against this temple and this city that you have heard.’

verses.kjv: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
verses.decoded: So change your behavior and actions, obey the LORD your God, and he will change his mind about the disaster he declared against you.

verses.kjv: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.
verses.decoded: As for me, I am in your hands—do to me whatever you think is right and proper.

verses.kjv: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
verses.decoded: But be sure of this: if you kill me, you will be responsible for innocent blood on yourselves, this city, and its people. The LORD truly sent me to speak all these words to you.

verses.kjv: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.
verses.decoded: Then the leaders and all the people said to the priests and prophets, 'This man does not deserve to die because he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.'

verses.kjv: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,
verses.decoded: Then some of the elders of the land stood up and spoke to the whole assembly of the people, saying,

verses.kjv: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
verses.decoded: Micah from Moresheth prophesied during King Hezekiah’s reign and told all the people of Judah, 'This is what the LORD Almighty says: Zion will be turned into a plowed field, Jerusalem will become ruins, and the temple hill will be like a forested high place.'

verses.kjv: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the LORD, and besought the LORD, and the LORD repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.
verses.decoded: Did King Hezekiah and all Judah kill Micah? No, they feared the LORD, pleaded with Him, and the LORD changed His mind about the disaster He had threatened. If we kill Jeremiah, we might bring great harm on ourselves.

verses.kjv: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:
verses.decoded: There was also a man named Urijah, son of Shemaiah from Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied in the LORD’s name against this city and land, just like Jeremiah did.

verses.kjv: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;
verses.decoded: When King Jehoiakim, his warriors, and officials heard Urijah’s words, the king wanted to kill him. But Urijah was afraid, so he fled to Egypt.

verses.kjv: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.
verses.decoded: King Jehoiakim sent men to Egypt, including Elnathan son of Achbor and others,

verses.kjv: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
verses.decoded: They brought Urijah out of Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, who killed him with a sword and threw his body into a common grave.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.decoded: But Ahikam son of Shaphan protected Jeremiah so that the people would not hand him over to be killed.

verses.kjv: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.decoded: At the start of King Jehoiakim's reign, who was Josiah's son and king of Judah, the LORD gave Jeremiah this message.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,
verses.decoded: The LORD told me, 'Make some bonds and yokes and put them on your neck.'

verses.kjv: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;
verses.decoded: Send these to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon through the messengers who come to Jerusalem to see King Zedekiah of Judah.

verses.kjv: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;
verses.decoded: Tell them to say to their rulers: 'This is what the LORD of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says.'

verses.kjv: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
verses.decoded: I created the earth, humans, and animals by my great power and strength, and I give them to whoever I choose.

verses.kjv: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.
verses.decoded: Now I have handed over all these lands to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, my servant; even the wild animals are under his control to serve him.

verses.kjv: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.
verses.decoded: All nations will serve Nebuchadnezzar, his son, and his grandson until his land's time is over. After that, many nations and powerful kings will take control from him.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the LORD, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
verses.decoded: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve Nebuchadnezzar and submit to his rule will be punished by me, the LORD, through war, famine, and disease until he destroys them.

verses.kjv: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:
verses.decoded: So do not listen to your prophets, fortune-tellers, dreamers, magicians, or sorcerers who tell you that you won’t have to serve the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.
verses.decoded: They are lying to you to make you leave your land, but I will force you out, and you will die.

verses.kjv: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the LORD; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
verses.decoded: But the nations that submit to the king of Babylon and serve him, I will allow them to stay in their land, where they will farm and live.

verses.kjv: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
verses.decoded: I also told King Zedekiah of Judah all these things: Submit to the king of Babylon, serve him and his people, and you will live.

verses.kjv: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.decoded: Why do you and your people want to die by war, famine, and disease, as the LORD said would happen to those who refuse to serve the king of Babylon?

verses.kjv: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.decoded: So do not listen to the prophets who tell you that you don’t have to serve the king of Babylon, because they are lying to you.

verses.kjv: For I have not sent them, saith the LORD, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.
verses.decoded: I did not send these prophets, says the LORD, yet they lie in my name to make you leave and die—both you and the false prophets.

verses.kjv: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD’s house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.decoded: I also spoke to the priests and all the people, saying, 'This is what the LORD says: Do not listen to the words of your prophets who tell you that the sacred items from the LORD’s temple will soon be brought back from Babylon. They are lying to you.'

verses.kjv: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?
verses.decoded: Do not listen to them; instead, submit to the king of Babylon and live. Why should this city be destroyed?

verses.kjv: But if they be prophets, and if the word of the LORD be with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
verses.decoded: But if these prophets are truly sent by God and have His word, let them pray to the LORD of hosts to prevent the sacred items left in the LORD’s temple, the king of Judah’s palace, and Jerusalem from being taken to Babylon.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD of hosts says about the pillars, the large basin, the stands, and the rest of the sacred items still in this city:

verses.kjv: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;
verses.decoded: These are the items that King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon did not take when he captured Jeconiah, son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem and brought them to Babylon.

verses.kjv: Yea, thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;
verses.decoded: Yes, this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says about the sacred items still in the LORD’s temple, the king of Judah’s palace, and Jerusalem:

verses.kjv: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the LORD; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.
verses.decoded: They will be taken to Babylon and remain there until the day I come to deal with them, says the LORD. Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
verses.decoded: In that same year, at the start of King Zedekiah's reign over Judah, in the fourth year and fifth month, Hananiah son of Azur, a prophet from Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the LORD, in front of the priests and all the people, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I have broken the control of the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD’s house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:
verses.decoded: Within two full years, I will return to this place all the sacred items from the LORD’s temple that King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon took away and brought to Babylon.

verses.kjv: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the LORD: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.decoded: I will also bring back Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, along with all the captives from Judah who were taken to Babylon, says the LORD, because I will break the control of the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD,
verses.decoded: Then the prophet Jeremiah spoke to the prophet Hananiah in front of the priests and all the people gathered in the house of the LORD,

verses.kjv: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the LORD do so: the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD’s house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.
verses.decoded: Jeremiah said, “Amen! May the LORD make your prophecy come true—may the LORD bring back the temple items and all the captives from Babylon to this place.”

verses.kjv: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;
verses.decoded: But now listen carefully to what I am about to say to you and to all the people here.

verses.kjv: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
verses.decoded: The prophets before us have always warned many nations and great kingdoms about war, disaster, and disease.

verses.kjv: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the LORD hath truly sent him.
verses.decoded: A prophet who predicts peace is only recognized as truly sent by the LORD when their prophecy actually happens.

verses.kjv: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and brake it.
verses.decoded: Then Hananiah took the wooden yoke from Jeremiah’s neck and broke it.

verses.kjv: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
verses.decoded: Hananiah said to all the people, “This is what the LORD says: I will break the yoke of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon from the neck of all nations within two full years.” Then Jeremiah left.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.decoded: After Hananiah broke the yoke from Jeremiah’s neck, the LORD gave Jeremiah this message:

verses.kjv: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.
verses.decoded: Go and tell Hananiah, ‘This is what the LORD says: You have broken wooden yokes, but you will replace them with iron yokes.’

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
verses.decoded: The LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I have placed an iron yoke on the necks of all these nations so they will serve King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, and they will serve him. I have even given him control over the wild animals.

verses.kjv: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The LORD hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.
verses.decoded: Then Jeremiah said to Hananiah, “Listen, Hananiah: The LORD did not send you. You are making these people believe a lie.”

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the LORD.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: I will remove you from the earth; you will die this year because you have encouraged people to rebel against the LORD.

verses.kjv: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
verses.decoded: Hananiah the prophet died in the seventh month of that same year.

verses.kjv: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;
verses.decoded: These are the words of the letter that the prophet Jeremiah sent from Jerusalem to the remaining elders who had been taken captive, along with the priests, prophets, and all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had exiled from Jerusalem to Babylon.

verses.kjv: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
verses.decoded: This was after King Jeconiah, the queen, the royal officials, the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, and skilled workers like carpenters and metalworkers had left Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
verses.decoded: The letter was delivered by Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom King Zedekiah of Judah had sent to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says to all the captives I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:

verses.kjv: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
verses.decoded: Build homes and live in them. Plant gardens and eat their produce.

verses.kjv: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.
verses.decoded: Marry and have children. Arrange marriages for your sons and daughters so your family will grow and not shrink while you are there.

verses.kjv: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
verses.decoded: Work for the welfare of the city where I have sent you into exile, and pray to the LORD for it, because your own peace depends on its peace.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Do not listen to the prophets and fortune-tellers among you who deceive you, or to the dreams you encourage them to have.

verses.kjv: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: They are prophesying lies to you in my name. I did not send them, declares the LORD.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
verses.decoded: The LORD says: After seventy years in Babylon, I will come to you and fulfill my promise by bringing you back to this place.

verses.kjv: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.decoded: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD—plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you a hopeful future.

verses.kjv: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
verses.decoded: When you call on me and come to pray to me, I will listen to you.

verses.kjv: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.decoded: You will seek me and find me when you search for me with all your heart.

verses.kjv: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
verses.decoded: I will be found by you, declares the LORD. I will end your captivity and gather you from all the nations where I have scattered you. I will bring you back to the place from which I sent you into exile.

verses.kjv: Because ye have said, The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;
verses.decoded: Because you say, ‘The LORD has raised up prophets for us in Babylon,’

verses.kjv: Know that thus saith the LORD of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
verses.decoded: Understand that this is what the LORD says about the king sitting on David's throne, all the people living in this city, and your relatives who did not go into exile with you.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.decoded: The LORD of armies says: I will bring sword, famine, and disease on them, and they will be like bad figs that are so rotten no one can eat them.

verses.kjv: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
verses.decoded: I will punish them with sword, famine, and disease, and scatter them to all the nations of the earth, where they will be a curse, a shock, a subject of mockery, and shame wherever I send them.

verses.kjv: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Because they refused to listen to my words, says the LORD, even though I sent my prophets to them repeatedly, but they would not listen.

verses.kjv: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.decoded: So listen to the word of the LORD, all you exiles I sent from Jerusalem to Babylon.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel, says about Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who falsely prophesy to you in my name: I will hand them over to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, and he will kill them right before you.

verses.kjv: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon, saying, The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;
verses.decoded: All the exiles from Judah in Babylon will curse them, saying, 'May the LORD make you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon burned in fire.'

verses.kjv: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours’ wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: They have done evil in Israel, committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and spoken lies in my name—words I never commanded. I know this and am a witness, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,
verses.decoded: You must also say this to Shemaiah the Nehelamite:

verses.kjv: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD of armies, the God of Israel, says: Because you sent letters in your own name to all the people in Jerusalem, to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

verses.kjv: The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD, for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.
verses.decoded: The LORD made you priest instead of Jehoiada so you could be a leader in the LORD’s house and punish anyone who acts crazy and claims to be a prophet by putting them in prison and stocks.

verses.kjv: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?
verses.decoded: So why haven’t you punished Jeremiah of Anathoth, who claims to be a prophet to you?

verses.kjv: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.decoded: Jeremiah sent this message to us in Babylon: This exile will last a long time, so build houses, live in them, plant gardens, and eat their produce.

verses.kjv: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.decoded: Zephaniah the priest read this letter aloud to Jeremiah the prophet.

verses.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.kjv: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:
verses.decoded: Send this message to all the exiles: This is what the LORD says about Shemaiah the Nehelamite. He prophesied to you, but I did not send him, and he made you believe a lie.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the LORD; because he hath taught rebellion against the LORD.
verses.decoded: So the LORD says: I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his descendants. None of his family will live among these people, and he will not see the good things I will do for my people, because he has encouraged rebellion against me.

verses.kjv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.decoded: This message came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
verses.decoded: The LORD God of Israel says, 'Write down all the words I have spoken to you in a book.'

verses.kjv: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, 'The time is coming when I will bring back my people Israel and Judah from captivity. I will bring them back to the land I gave their ancestors, and they will own it again.'

verses.kjv: And these are the words that the LORD spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
verses.decoded: These are the words the LORD spoke about Israel and Judah.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, 'We have heard a sound of trembling and fear, not peace.'

verses.kjv: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
verses.decoded: Look and ask, 'Does a man give birth?' So why do I see every man holding his side like a woman in labor, with pale faces?

verses.kjv: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble, but he shall be saved out of it.
verses.decoded: Woe to that day! It will be so terrible that no other day is like it. It is the time of Jacob’s distress, but he will be saved.

verses.kjv: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:
verses.decoded: On that day, says the LORD of hosts, I will remove the yoke from your neck and break your chains. Foreigners will no longer enslave you.

verses.kjv: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
verses.decoded: Instead, they will serve the LORD their God and their king David, whom I will raise up for them.

verses.kjv: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.decoded: So don’t be afraid, my servant Jacob, says the LORD. Don’t be discouraged, Israel. I will save you from far away and bring your descendants back from captivity. Jacob will return and live in peace without fear.

verses.kjv: For I am with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.
verses.decoded: I am with you to save you, says the LORD. Even though I destroy all the nations where I scattered you, I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you fairly but will not abandon you.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, 'Your injury is severe and cannot be healed; your wound is serious.'

verses.kjv: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
verses.decoded: No one is there to defend you or heal your wounds; you have no medicine to cure you.

verses.kjv: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.
verses.decoded: All your friends have forgotten you and don’t look for you. I have hurt you like an enemy would, punishing you severely because your sins have grown so many.

verses.kjv: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.
verses.decoded: Why do you cry out over your suffering? Your pain cannot be healed because of your many sins. I have done this to you because your sins have grown.
