verses.kjv: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
verses.decoded: Everyone who harms you will be harmed in return; all your enemies will be taken captive. Those who steal from you will themselves be stolen from, and those who attack you will become the victims.

verses.kjv: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
verses.decoded: I will bring you back to health and heal your wounds, says the LORD, because people have rejected you and said, 'This is Zion, no one cares about her.'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
verses.decoded: The LORD says: I will restore the homes of Jacob's people and show mercy to their towns. The city will be rebuilt on its own ruins, and the palace will be restored as before.

verses.kjv: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
verses.decoded: From them will come songs of thanks and joyful voices. I will increase their numbers so they will not be few, and I will honor them so they will not be insignificant.

verses.kjv: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
verses.decoded: Their children will be like they were in the past, and their community will be firmly established before me. I will punish everyone who oppresses them.

verses.kjv: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Their leaders will come from among themselves, and their ruler will arise from their own people. I will bring him close to me, and he will come near to me. Who is this who is determined to come near to me? says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.decoded: You will be my people, and I will be your God.

verses.kjv: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
verses.decoded: Look, the LORD’s storm goes out in anger, a fierce and relentless whirlwind. It will strike the heads of the wicked with pain.

verses.kjv: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.
verses.decoded: The LORD’s fierce anger will not stop until He has completed what He planned and accomplished the purposes of His heart. In the future, you will understand this.

verses.kjv: At the same time, saith the LORD, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
verses.decoded: At that time, says the LORD, I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: The people who survived the sword found favor in the wilderness—Israel when I led him to rest.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
verses.decoded: The LORD appeared to me long ago and said, 'I have loved you with an eternal love; that is why I have continued to show you kindness.'

verses.kjv: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
verses.decoded: I will rebuild you, and you will be rebuilt, O virgin Israel; you will once again be decorated with tambourines and join in joyful dances.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.
verses.decoded: You will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; the planters will plant and enjoy their fruit as something ordinary.

verses.kjv: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD our God.
verses.decoded: There will come a day when the watchmen on Mount Ephraim will shout, 'Let’s go up to Zion, to the LORD our God!'

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O LORD, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: Sing joyfully for Jacob and shout among the leaders of the nations; announce and praise, saying, 'O LORD, save your people, the remaining Israelites.'

verses.kjv: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
verses.decoded: Look, I will bring them back from the north and gather them from the farthest places on earth—those who are blind, lame, pregnant, or in labor—a large group will return there.

verses.kjv: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
verses.decoded: They will come weeping, and I will lead them with prayers; I will guide them along straight paths beside flowing streams where they won’t stumble. I am like a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.

verses.kjv: Hear the word of the LORD, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.
verses.decoded: Listen to the word of the LORD, all nations, and announce it to distant islands: The one who scattered Israel will gather them and watch over them like a shepherd watches his sheep.

verses.kjv: For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.
verses.decoded: The LORD has redeemed Jacob and rescued him from the power of someone stronger.

verses.kjv: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
verses.decoded: So they will come and sing on the heights of Zion, gathering together to enjoy the blessings of the LORD—wheat, wine, oil, and young animals—and their souls will be like a well-watered garden; they will never be sad again.

verses.kjv: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verses.decoded: Then the young women will celebrate with dancing, young and old together, because I will change their sadness into happiness, comfort them, and make them joyful instead of sorrowful.

verses.kjv: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will satisfy the priests with abundance, and my people will be filled with my blessings, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: A voice was heard in Ramah—lamentation and bitter weeping. Rachel was crying for her children and refused to be comforted because they were gone.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, stop crying and wipe away your tears, because your efforts will be rewarded. Your people will return from the land of their enemies.

verses.kjv: And there is hope in thine end, saith the LORD, that thy children shall come again to their own border.
verses.decoded: The LORD says there is hope for your future; your children will return to their own land.

verses.kjv: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art the LORD my God.
verses.decoded: I have heard Ephraim complaining, saying, 'You have disciplined me, and I accepted it, like an ox not used to a yoke. Please guide me, and I will return, because you are the LORD my God.'

verses.kjv: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
verses.decoded: After I turned back, I felt sorry; after I was taught, I struck my thigh in shame because I carried the disgrace of my youth.

verses.kjv: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Is Ephraim my beloved son? Is he a dear child? Even though I spoke against him, I still remember him deeply. My heart aches for him, and I will have mercy on him, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
verses.decoded: Mark your path with signs and build landmarks; focus your heart on the road you traveled. Return, Israel, and come back to your towns.

verses.kjv: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
verses.decoded: How long will you wander, you unfaithful daughter? The LORD has done something new on earth: a woman will surround a man.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The LORD bless thee, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.
verses.decoded: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: People in Judah and its cities will soon say, 'The LORD bless you, you place of justice and holy mountain,' when I restore their captivity.

verses.kjv: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.
verses.decoded: Farmers and shepherds will live in Judah and all its cities together.

verses.kjv: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
verses.decoded: I have satisfied the tired soul and refreshed every sorrowful heart.

verses.kjv: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
verses.decoded: When I thought about this, I woke up and saw it clearly, and my sleep was peaceful.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, the time is coming when I will plant the people of Israel and Judah like seeds—both humans and animals.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Just as I have watched over them to uproot, destroy, and punish, I will also watch over them to build and plant, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.
verses.decoded: In those days, people will no longer say, 'The parents have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.'

verses.kjv: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.decoded: Instead, each person will be responsible for their own sins; anyone who sins will face the consequences themselves.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
verses.decoded: Look, the time is coming, says the LORD, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and Judah.

verses.kjv: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the LORD:
verses.decoded: It won’t be like the agreement I made with their ancestors when I led them out of Egypt by the hand. They broke that covenant, even though I was like a husband to them, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.decoded: But this is the new agreement I will make with Israel: After that time, I will put my law inside them and write it on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

verses.kjv: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
verses.decoded: No one will need to teach their neighbor or brother to know the LORD, because everyone will know me—from the least to the greatest. I will forgive their sins and never remember their wrongs again.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts is his name:
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says, who made the sun to shine by day, and the moon and stars to give light by night, who controls the sea and its roaring waves—the LORD Almighty is his name.

verses.kjv: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
verses.decoded: If these natural laws stop working, says the LORD, then Israel will also cease to exist as a nation before me forever.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: If the heavens above can be measured or the earth’s foundations explored, then I will reject all of Israel because of what they have done, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.
verses.decoded: Look, the time is coming, says the LORD, when the city will be rebuilt for the LORD—from the Tower of Hananeel to the Corner Gate.

verses.kjv: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
verses.decoded: A measuring line will be stretched out over the hill of Gareb and will circle around to Goath.

verses.kjv: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
verses.decoded: The entire valley of dead bodies and ashes, all the fields up to the Kidron Brook and the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, will be sacred to the LORD. It will never be destroyed or ruined again.

verses.kjv: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
verses.decoded: The message from the LORD came to Jeremiah in the tenth year of King Zedekiah of Judah, which was also the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar's reign.

verses.kjv: For then the king of Babylon’s army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Judah’s house.
verses.decoded: At that time, the Babylonian army was surrounding Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was confined in the prison courtyard located in the king of Judah’s palace.

verses.kjv: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
verses.decoded: King Zedekiah had imprisoned him, asking why he kept prophesying that the LORD said He would hand the city over to the king of Babylon, who would capture it.

verses.kjv: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;
verses.decoded: Zedekiah will not escape the Babylonians; he will be captured and handed over to the king of Babylon, where they will speak face to face and look each other in the eyes.

verses.kjv: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the LORD: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper.
verses.decoded: The king of Babylon will take Zedekiah to Babylon, where he will remain until the LORD decides to act. Even if you fight the Babylonians, you will not succeed.

verses.kjv: And Jeremiah said, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: Jeremiah said, 'The LORD’s message came to me, saying,'

verses.kjv: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is thine to buy it.
verses.decoded: 'Look, Hanameel, the son of your uncle Shallum, will come to you and ask you to buy his field in Anathoth, because you have the right to redeem it.'

verses.kjv: So Hanameel mine uncle’s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Hanameel, my uncle’s son, came to me in the prison courtyard as the LORD had said and asked me to buy his field in Anathoth, in Benjamin’s territory, because I had the right to inherit and redeem it. Then I realized this was truly the LORD’s message.

verses.kjv: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle’s son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.decoded: I bought Hanameel’s field in Anathoth and paid him seventeen shekels of silver.

verses.kjv: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.
verses.decoded: I wrote the deed, sealed it, got witnesses, and weighed out the money on the scales.

verses.kjv: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
verses.decoded: I took both the sealed legal document and the open copy of the purchase agreement.

verses.kjv: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle’s son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.
verses.decoded: I gave the purchase documents to Baruch, son of Neriah, in front of Hanameel and the witnesses, and before all the Jews sitting in the prison courtyard.

verses.kjv: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,
verses.decoded: I instructed Baruch in front of everyone, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.
verses.decoded: 'This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Take these purchase documents, both the sealed and open copies, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.'

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.
verses.decoded: The LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: People will once again own houses, fields, and vineyards in this land.

verses.kjv: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD, saying,
verses.decoded: After I gave the proof of the purchase to Baruch, son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD, saying,

verses.kjv: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:
verses.decoded: O Lord GOD, you made the heavens and the earth by your great power and outstretched arm; nothing is too difficult or hidden from you.

verses.kjv: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the LORD of hosts, is his name,
verses.decoded: You show kindness to thousands and repay the sins of the fathers to their children and grandchildren. You are the Great and Mighty God, the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
verses.decoded: You are wise in planning and powerful in action; your eyes watch over all people to give each one what they deserve based on their actions.

verses.kjv: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Israel, and among other men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;
verses.decoded: You have performed signs and wonders in Egypt, in Israel, and among other nations, and you have made a name for yourself that still stands today.

verses.kjv: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;
verses.decoded: You brought your people Israel out of Egypt with signs, wonders, a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and great fear.

verses.kjv: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
verses.decoded: You gave them this land, which you promised their ancestors, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.kjv: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:
verses.decoded: They entered and took possession of it, but they did not obey your voice or follow your law; they did nothing you commanded. Because of this, you allowed all this disaster to happen to them.

verses.kjv: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest it.
verses.decoded: Look, the siege engines have arrived at the city to capture it, and the city is handed over to the Chaldeans who fight it with sword, famine, and disease. What you said has happened, and now you see it.

verses.kjv: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord GOD, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.decoded: And you told me, O Lord GOD, 'Buy the field with money and get witnesses, because the city will be handed over to the Chaldeans.'

verses.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.kjv: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
verses.decoded: I am the LORD, the God of all people. Is anything too difficult for me?

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:
verses.decoded: Therefore, the LORD says: I will hand this city over to the Chaldeans and to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, and he will capture it.

verses.kjv: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.
verses.decoded: The Chaldeans attacking this city will come and set it on fire, burning the houses where people have offered incense to Baal and poured out drink offerings to other gods, provoking my anger.

verses.kjv: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel and Judah have done evil in my sight from their youth; Israel has continually angered me with what their hands have done, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,
verses.decoded: This city has been a constant cause of my anger and fury ever since it was built, right up to today; because of this, I have decided to remove it from my presence.

verses.kjv: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: This is because of all the evil the people of Israel and Judah have done to anger me—the kings, princes, priests, prophets, the people of Judah, and the residents of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
verses.decoded: They have turned their backs on me instead of facing me; even though I got up early and taught them, they refused to listen or accept my guidance.

verses.kjv: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.
verses.decoded: Instead, they placed their disgusting idols in my temple—the place named after me—to defile it.

verses.kjv: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.
verses.decoded: They built altars to Baal in the valley of Hinnom and sacrificed their children by fire to Molech, something I never commanded or even imagined they would do—this abomination caused Judah to sin.

verses.kjv: And now therefore thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;
verses.decoded: Now the LORD, the God of Israel, says about this city—which you say will be handed over to the king of Babylon by sword, famine, and disease—

verses.kjv: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
verses.decoded: I will gather them from all the countries where I scattered them in my anger and wrath, and bring them back here to live safely.

verses.kjv: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:
verses.decoded: They will be my people, and I will be their God.

verses.kjv: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:
verses.decoded: I will give them a united heart and purpose so they will always respect me—for their own good and for the good of their descendants.

verses.kjv: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
verses.decoded: I will make an eternal agreement with them, promising never to abandon them but to bless them; I will put my reverence in their hearts so they will never turn away from me.

verses.kjv: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.
verses.decoded: I will be glad to bless them, and I will firmly plant them in this land with all my heart and soul.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.
verses.decoded: The LORD says: Just as I have brought great disaster on these people, I will also bring all the good I have promised them.

verses.kjv: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.decoded: People will buy fields in this land, even though you say it is empty and ruined, controlled by the Babylonians.

verses.kjv: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: People will buy land with money, sign contracts, seal them, and have witnesses in Benjamin, around Jerusalem, and throughout Judah’s cities—in the mountains, valleys, and southern areas—because I will bring back their captives, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to Jeremiah again while he was still confined in the prison courtyard, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD the maker thereof, the LORD that formed it, to establish it; the LORD is his name;
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says—the one who made it, formed it, and established it—the LORD is his name.

verses.kjv: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
verses.decoded: Call on me, and I will answer you and show you great and powerful things you do not know.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says about the houses in this city and the houses of the kings of Judah that have been destroyed by the hills and by the sword:

verses.kjv: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.
verses.decoded: Enemies come to fight against the Chaldeans, but they will be filled with dead bodies—people I have killed in my anger and fury because of their wickedness, and because I turned away from this city.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.
verses.decoded: Look, I will bring health and healing; I will heal them and reveal to them great peace and truth.

verses.kjv: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.
verses.decoded: I will bring back the captives of Judah and Israel and rebuild them just like before.

verses.kjv: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.
verses.decoded: I will forgive all their sins and cleanse them from everything they have done wrong against me.

verses.kjv: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.
verses.decoded: This will bring me joy, praise, and honor among all the nations who hear about the good things I do for them. They will respect and fear me because of the blessings and prosperity I give.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: In this place you say will be empty and without people or animals—in the cities of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem that are now deserted—there will again be life and activity.

verses.kjv: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts: for the LORD is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: You will hear joyful voices, gladness, the voices of bridegrooms and brides, and people saying, 'Praise the LORD of hosts, for the LORD is good and his mercy lasts forever.' They will bring offerings of praise to the house of the LORD. I will restore the land’s captives just like before, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD of hosts says: In this place, now empty and without people or animals, and in all its cities, shepherds will live again and care for their flocks.

verses.kjv: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: In the mountain cities, the valley cities, the southern cities, the land of Benjamin, around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, flocks will again be cared for by their shepherds, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.
verses.decoded: Look, the time is coming, says the LORD, when I will fulfill the good promises I made to the people of Israel and Judah.

verses.kjv: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.
verses.decoded: At that time, I will raise up a righteous descendant from David’s line, who will rule with justice and fairness in the land.

verses.kjv: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The LORD our righteousness.
verses.decoded: In that time, Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will live in safety. She will be called 'The LORD Our Righteousness.'

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;
verses.decoded: The LORD says that there will always be a descendant of David to sit on the throne of Israel; David’s line will never be cut off.

verses.kjv: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.
verses.decoded: Likewise, the Levite priests will always have someone to serve before me, offering burnt offerings, grain offerings, and performing sacrifices continuously.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;
verses.decoded: The LORD says: If you can break my covenant that controls day and night, so that day and night no longer happen at their proper times,

verses.kjv: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.
verses.decoded: Then my covenant with David, my servant, could be broken so that he would have no son to rule on his throne; and the same for the Levite priests who serve me.

verses.kjv: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.
verses.decoded: Just as the stars in the sky cannot be counted and the sand on the seashore cannot be measured, I will multiply David’s descendants and the Levite priests who serve me.

verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.decoded: Again, the LORD spoke to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.kjv: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.
verses.decoded: Have you not heard what these people say? They claim the LORD has rejected the two families He chose, despising my people so they are no longer a nation.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;
verses.decoded: The LORD says: If my covenant does not stand with day and night, and if I have not set the laws for the heavens and the earth,

verses.kjv: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.
verses.decoded: Then I will reject Jacob’s descendants and David’s line so that none of his descendants will rule over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. But I will bring them back from captivity and show them mercy.

verses.kjv: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,
verses.decoded: This message came to Jeremiah from the LORD during the time when Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, along with his entire army and all the kingdoms under his control, were fighting against Jerusalem and all its cities.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:
verses.decoded: The LORD, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell King Zedekiah of Judah that I will hand this city over to the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.
verses.decoded: You will not escape from his control; you will be captured and handed over to him. You will see the king of Babylon face to face, and he will speak directly to you, then you will be taken to Babylon.

verses.kjv: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:
verses.decoded: But listen to the LORD’s message, King Zedekiah of Judah: The LORD says you will not die by the sword.

verses.kjv: But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Instead, you will die peacefully. Like your ancestors, the former kings before you, you will be honored with funeral offerings, and people will mourn for you, saying, 'Ah lord!' This is what the LORD has declared.

verses.kjv: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,
verses.decoded: Then the prophet Jeremiah spoke all these words to King Zedekiah of Judah in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: When the king of Babylon’s army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.
verses.decoded: This happened while the Babylonian army was attacking Jerusalem and all the remaining cities of Judah, including Lachish and Azekah, which were the fortified cities still standing in Judah.

verses.kjv: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;
verses.decoded: This is the message Jeremiah received from the LORD after King Zedekiah made a promise with all the people in Jerusalem to declare freedom for them.

verses.kjv: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew his brother.
verses.decoded: The agreement was that everyone should free their male and female Hebrew servants so that no one would keep their fellow Jewish brothers or sisters as slaves.

verses.kjv: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.
verses.decoded: When the leaders and all the people who agreed to the covenant heard that everyone was supposed to free their servants and no longer keep them as slaves, they obeyed and set them free.

verses.kjv: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
verses.decoded: But later, they changed their minds and forced the servants and maidservants they had freed to come back and serve as slaves again.

verses.kjv: Therefore the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.decoded: Because of this, the LORD gave Jeremiah another message, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD, the God of Israel, says: I made a covenant with your ancestors the day I brought them out of Egypt, freeing them from slavery, saying,

verses.kjv: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.
verses.decoded: After seven years, you must free your Hebrew brother who has been sold to you. After he has served six years, you must let him go free. But your ancestors did not listen to me or pay attention.

verses.kjv: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:
verses.decoded: But now you have changed and done what is right in my eyes by declaring freedom to each other, and you made a covenant before me in the temple, which is named after me.

verses.kjv: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom he had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.
verses.decoded: But you changed your mind and dishonored my name by forcing every servant and maid you had freed to come back and serve you again as slaves.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the LORD, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.decoded: Because you did not listen to me when you declared freedom to your brothers and neighbors, I now declare freedom for you—from life itself—through war, disease, and famine. I will scatter you among all the nations of the earth.

verses.kjv: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,
verses.decoded: I will hand over to their enemies those who broke my covenant and did not keep the promises they made before me when they cut the calf in two and walked between the pieces.

verses.kjv: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;
verses.decoded: This includes the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the officials, the priests, and all the people who took part in that covenant ceremony.

verses.kjv: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.
verses.decoded: I will deliver them into the hands of their enemies and those who want to kill them, and their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and the animals of the earth.

verses.kjv: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which are gone up from you.
verses.decoded: I will also hand King Zedekiah of Judah and his officials over to their enemies, to those who want to kill them, and to the army of the king of Babylon that has come against you.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will command, saith the LORD, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.decoded: I will order the Babylonians to return to this city; they will attack it, capture it, and burn it down. I will leave the cities of Judah empty and desolate, with no people living there.

verses.kjv: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD gave Jeremiah this message during the reign of Jehoiakim, son of Josiah, king of Judah.

verses.kjv: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.
verses.decoded: Go to the Rechabites' home, talk to them, bring them into the LORD’s temple into one of the rooms, and offer them wine to drink.

verses.kjv: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
verses.decoded: So I brought Jaazaniah, son of Jeremiah, son of Habaziniah, along with his brothers, sons, and all the Rechabites.

verses.kjv: And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:
verses.decoded: I brought them into the LORD’s temple, into the room of the sons of Hanan, son of Igdaliah, a man of God. This room was near the princes’ chamber and above the room of Maaseiah, son of Shallum, the doorkeeper.

verses.kjv: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.
verses.decoded: I placed pots of wine and cups in front of the Rechabites and told them, 'Drink some wine.'

verses.kjv: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, neither ye, nor your sons for ever:
verses.decoded: But they replied, 'We won’t drink wine because our ancestor Jonadab, son of Rechab, commanded us never to drink wine, not us or our children, forever.'

verses.kjv: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers.
verses.decoded: He also commanded us not to build houses, plant crops, or vineyards, but to live in tents all our lives so we would live long in the land where we are foreigners.

verses.kjv: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;
verses.decoded: We have obeyed Jonadab’s commands in everything, never drinking wine all our lives, including our wives, sons, and daughters.

verses.kjv: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:
verses.decoded: We have not built houses to live in, nor do we have vineyards, fields, or seeds.

verses.kjv: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
verses.decoded: Instead, we have lived in tents and obeyed all the commands Jonadab gave us.

verses.kjv: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: When King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon invaded the land, we decided to go to Jerusalem because we feared the armies of the Babylonians and Syrians, so we lived there.

verses.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to Jeremiah again, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the people of Judah and Jerusalem, 'Won’t you listen and obey my words?' says the LORD.

verses.kjv: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father’s commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.
verses.decoded: The command of Jonadab, son of Rechab, not to drink wine has been kept; even now they don’t drink wine and obey their ancestor’s command. But I have spoken to you repeatedly, yet you have not listened to me.

verses.kjv: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.
verses.decoded: I have sent all my servants, the prophets, early and often, telling you to turn away from your evil ways, change your actions, and stop worshiping other gods, so you could live in the land I gave you and your ancestors. But you have not listened or obeyed me.

verses.kjv: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:
verses.decoded: The descendants of Jonadab, son of Rechab, have obeyed their father's instructions, but the people of Israel have not listened to me.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.
verses.decoded: So the LORD, the God of Israel's armies, says: I will bring all the punishments I warned about on Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem, because I spoke to them but they didn’t listen, and I called to them but they didn’t respond.

verses.kjv: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:
verses.decoded: Jeremiah told the Rechabites, 'This is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Because you obeyed the commands of your father Jonadab, kept all his rules, and did everything he told you to do,'

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.
verses.decoded: Therefore, the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: There will always be a descendant of Jonadab son of Rechab standing before me.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that this word came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.decoded: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim, son of Josiah, king of Judah, the LORD gave Jeremiah this message:

verses.kjv: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.
verses.decoded: Take a scroll and write down all the words I have spoken to you about Israel, Judah, and all the nations, from the time I first spoke to you during King Josiah’s reign until now.

verses.kjv: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.
verses.decoded: Maybe the people of Judah will hear about the disaster I plan for them, turn away from their evil ways, and I will forgive their sins.

verses.kjv: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.
verses.decoded: Jeremiah called Baruch, son of Neriah, and Baruch wrote down all the words the LORD had spoken to Jeremiah on a scroll.

verses.kjv: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go into the house of the LORD:
verses.decoded: Jeremiah told Baruch, “I am confined and cannot enter the LORD’s temple.

verses.kjv: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the LORD’s house upon the fasting day: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.
verses.decoded: So you go and read aloud the scroll you wrote from my words to the people in the LORD’s temple on the day of fasting. Also, read it to all the people of Judah who come from their towns.

verses.kjv: It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD, and will return every one from his evil way: for great is the anger and the fury that the LORD hath pronounced against this people.
verses.decoded: Maybe they will pray to the LORD and each turn away from their evil ways, because the LORD’s anger and fury against them is very great.

verses.kjv: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of the LORD in the LORD’s house.
verses.decoded: Baruch, son of Neriah, did exactly as Jeremiah commanded and read the LORD’s words from the scroll in the LORD’s temple.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: In the fifth year of Jehoiakim, son of Josiah, king of Judah, during the ninth month, a fast was announced to all the people in Jerusalem and to everyone who came from the towns of Judah to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD’s house, in the ears of all the people.
verses.decoded: Baruch read Jeremiah’s words from the scroll in the LORD’s temple, in the room of Gemariah, son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper courtyard by the entrance of the new gate of the LORD’s temple, in front of all the people.

verses.kjv: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the LORD,
verses.decoded: When Michaiah, son of Gemariah, son of Shaphan, heard all the LORD’s words from the scroll,

verses.kjv: Then he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
verses.decoded: He went to the king’s palace, into the scribe’s room, where all the officials were sitting: Elishama the scribe, Delaiah son of Shemaiah, Elnathan son of Achbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the other officials.

verses.kjv: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.
verses.decoded: Michaiah told them all the words he had heard when Baruch read the scroll to the people.

verses.kjv: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand, and came unto them.
verses.decoded: So the officials sent Jehudi, son of Nethaniah, son of Shelemiah, son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, “Take the scroll you read to the people and come with it.” Baruch took the scroll and went to them.

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.
verses.decoded: They told Baruch, “Sit down and read it to us.” So Baruch read it aloud to them.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.
verses.decoded: After hearing everything, they were all afraid and said to Baruch, "We will definitely report all these words to the king."

verses.kjv: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How didst thou write all these words at his mouth?
verses.decoded: They asked Baruch, "Tell us, how did you write down all these words as he spoke them?"

verses.kjv: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.
verses.decoded: Baruch answered, "Jeremiah spoke all these words to me, and I wrote them down with ink in the scroll."

verses.kjv: Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide thee, thou and Jeremiah; and let no man know where ye be.
verses.decoded: Then the officials said to Baruch, "Go hide yourself and Jeremiah, and don’t let anyone know where you are."

verses.kjv: And they went in to the king into the court, but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the ears of the king.
verses.decoded: They went to the king’s court but kept the scroll in Elishama the scribe’s room, and they reported all the words to the king.

verses.kjv: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll: and he took it out of Elishama the scribe’s chamber. And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king.
verses.decoded: The king sent Jehudi to get the scroll from Elishama’s room. Jehudi read it aloud to the king and all the officials standing nearby.

verses.kjv: Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and there was a fire on the hearth burning before him.
verses.decoded: The king was sitting in his winter palace in the ninth month, with a fire burning on the hearth in front of him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.
verses.decoded: After Jehudi read three or four pages, he cut the scroll with a knife and threw it into the fire on the hearth until the whole scroll was burned up.

verses.kjv: Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments, neither the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.
verses.decoded: But neither the king nor his officials who heard the words were afraid or tore their clothes in distress.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll: but he would not hear them.
verses.decoded: However, Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah pleaded with the king not to burn the scroll, but he refused to listen.

verses.kjv: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet: but the LORD hid them.
verses.decoded: The king ordered Jerahmeel son of Hammelech, Seraiah son of Azriel, and Shelemiah son of Abdeel to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet, but the LORD hid them.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the roll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,
verses.decoded: After the king burned the scroll and the words Baruch had written from Jeremiah, the LORD spoke to Jeremiah again, saying,

verses.kjv: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.
verses.decoded: Take another scroll and write on it all the words that were on the first scroll, which King Jehoiakim of Judah burned.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim king of Judah, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast burned this roll, saying, Why hast thou written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?
verses.decoded: Tell King Jehoiakim, ‘This is what the LORD says: You burned this scroll, saying, “Why did you write that the king of Babylon will come and destroy this land and wipe out both people and animals?”’

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of Jehoiakim king of Judah; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.
verses.decoded: Therefore, this is what the LORD says about King Jehoiakim of Judah: He will have no one to succeed him on the throne of David, and his dead body will be left out in the heat by day and the cold by night.

verses.kjv: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and upon the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them; but they hearkened not.
verses.decoded: I will punish him, his descendants, and his servants for their sins. I will bring all the disasters I warned about upon them, the people of Jerusalem, and the men of Judah, but they did not listen.

verses.kjv: Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.
verses.decoded: Then Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to Baruch the scribe, son of Neriah. Baruch wrote on it all the words from Jeremiah that were in the scroll King Jehoiakim had burned, and he added many similar words as well.

verses.kjv: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.
verses.decoded: King Zedekiah, son of Josiah, became king in place of Coniah, son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, had appointed king over Judah.

verses.kjv: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did hearken unto the words of the LORD, which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah.
verses.decoded: But neither Zedekiah, his officials, nor the people listened to the LORD’s messages delivered through the prophet Jeremiah.

verses.kjv: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now unto the LORD our God for us.
verses.decoded: King Zedekiah sent Jehucal, son of Shelemiah, and Zephaniah, son of Maaseiah the priest, to Jeremiah, asking him to pray to the LORD on their behalf.

verses.kjv: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had not put him into prison.
verses.decoded: Jeremiah was free to move among the people because they had not imprisoned him.

verses.kjv: Then Pharaoh’s army was come forth out of Egypt: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them, they departed from Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Pharaoh’s army came out of Egypt, and when the Babylonians besieging Jerusalem heard about it, they left the city.

verses.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD unto the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah, that sent you unto me to enquire of me; Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Tell the king of Judah who sent you to ask me that Pharaoh’s army, which came to help, will return to Egypt.

verses.kjv: And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city, and take it, and burn it with fire.
verses.decoded: The Babylonians will come back, attack the city, capture it, and burn it down.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, don’t fool yourselves by thinking the Babylonians will leave; they will not leave.

verses.kjv: For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you, and there remained but wounded men among them, yet should they rise up every man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.
verses.decoded: Even if you defeated the entire Babylonian army except for some wounded men, they would still get up in their tents and burn the city down.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,
verses.decoded: When the Babylonian army left Jerusalem because they were afraid of Pharaoh’s army,

verses.kjv: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.
verses.decoded: Jeremiah left Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, trying to slip away quietly among the people.

verses.kjv: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he took Jeremiah the prophet, saying, Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans.
verses.decoded: At the Benjamin Gate, a captain named Irijah, son of Shelemiah, arrested Jeremiah, accusing him of defecting to the Babylonians.

verses.kjv: Then said Jeremiah, It is false; I fall not away to the Chaldeans. But he hearkened not to him: so Irijah took Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.
verses.decoded: Jeremiah denied it, saying it was a lie and he had not defected, but Irijah didn’t listen and took him to the officials.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe: for they had made that the prison.
verses.decoded: The officials became angry with Jeremiah, beat him, and put him in prison in Jonathan the scribe’s house, which they had turned into a prison.

verses.kjv: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon, and into the cabins, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;
verses.decoded: Jeremiah was put into the dungeon and the cells, and he stayed there for many days.

verses.kjv: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took him out: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there any word from the LORD? And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said he, thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.
verses.decoded: King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah and secretly asked him at his house, 'Is there any message from the LORD?' Jeremiah replied, 'Yes, you will be handed over to the king of Babylon.'

verses.kjv: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against thee, or against thy servants, or against this people, that ye have put me in prison?
verses.decoded: Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, 'What wrong have I done to you, your officials, or this people that you have put me in prison?'

verses.kjv: Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?
verses.decoded: Where are the prophets who told you that the king of Babylon would not attack you or this land?

verses.kjv: Therefore hear now, I pray thee, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray thee, be accepted before thee; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.
verses.decoded: So please listen to me, my lord the king. Accept my request and don’t send me back to Jonathan the scribe’s house, or I will die there.

verses.kjv: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city were spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
verses.decoded: King Zedekiah ordered that Jeremiah be placed in the prison courtyard and given a daily piece of bread from the bakers’ street until the city’s bread supply was gone. Jeremiah stayed there.

verses.kjv: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchiah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,
verses.decoded: Shephatiah son of Mattan, Gedaliah son of Pashur, Jucal son of Shelemiah, and Pashur son of Malchiah heard the things Jeremiah said to all the people,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live; for he shall have his life for a prey, and shall live.
verses.decoded: The LORD says: Anyone who stays in this city will die by the sword, famine, or disease; but anyone who surrenders to the Babylonians will live—they will be spared and survive.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which shall take it.
verses.decoded: The LORD says this city will definitely be handed over to the Babylonian king’s army, who will capture it.

verses.kjv: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech thee, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.
verses.decoded: So the officials said to the king, 'Please, have this man killed, because his words are discouraging our soldiers and the people. He isn’t trying to help us but to harm us.'

verses.kjv: Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand: for the king is not he that can do any thing against you.
verses.decoded: King Zedekiah replied, 'He is in your hands; the king can’t stop you from doing what you want.'

verses.kjv: Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech, that was in the court of the prison: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. And in the dungeon there was no water, but mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.
verses.decoded: They took Jeremiah and threw him into Malchiah’s cistern in the prison courtyard, lowering him down with ropes. The cistern had no water, only mud, and Jeremiah sank into the mud.

verses.kjv: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, one of the eunuchs which was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin;
verses.decoded: When Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, a eunuch in the king’s palace, heard Jeremiah was thrown into the cistern, the king was sitting at the Benjamin gate.

verses.kjv: Ebedmelech went forth out of the king’s house, and spake to the king, saying,
verses.decoded: Ebedmelech left the king’s palace and spoke to the king, saying,

verses.kjv: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for there is no more bread in the city.
verses.decoded: My lord the king, these men have done wrong by throwing Jeremiah the prophet into the cistern. He is likely to starve to death there because there is no more bread in the city.

verses.kjv: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with thee, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.
verses.decoded: The king ordered Ebedmelech, 'Take thirty men with you and rescue Jeremiah the prophet from the cistern before he dies.'

verses.kjv: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.
verses.decoded: Ebedmelech took the men and went to the king’s treasury, where he got old worn-out cloths and rags and lowered them by ropes into the cistern to Jeremiah.

verses.kjv: And Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah, Put now these old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords. And Jeremiah did so.
verses.decoded: Ebedmelech told Jeremiah to place the old cloths and rags under his arms to protect himself from the ropes. Jeremiah did as he was told.

verses.kjv: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
verses.decoded: They pulled Jeremiah up with ropes and brought him out of the cistern. Jeremiah stayed in the prison courtyard.

verses.kjv: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of the LORD: and the king said unto Jeremiah, I will ask thee a thing; hide nothing from me.
verses.decoded: King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah and brought him into the third room in the temple. The king said, 'I will ask you something; don’t hide anything from me.'

verses.kjv: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare it unto thee, wilt thou not surely put me to death? and if I give thee counsel, wilt thou not hearken unto me?
verses.decoded: Jeremiah replied, 'If I tell you the truth, won’t you kill me? And if I give you advice, won’t you ignore it?'

verses.kjv: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, As the LORD liveth, that made us this soul, I will not put thee to death, neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life.
verses.decoded: King Zedekiah secretly promised Jeremiah, "As the LORD lives, who created us, I will not kill you or hand you over to the men who want to harm you."

verses.kjv: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon’s princes, then thy soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and thou shalt live, and thine house:
verses.decoded: Jeremiah told Zedekiah, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: If you go to the officials of the king of Babylon, you will live, this city will not be destroyed by fire, and you and your family will survive."

verses.kjv: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape out of their hand.
verses.decoded: But if you refuse to go to the Babylonian officials, the city will be captured by the Babylonians, burned, and you will be caught and not escape.
