verses.decoded: Just like the destruction of Sodom, Gomorrah, and nearby cities, says the LORD, no one will live there anymore; no human will settle there.

verses.kjv: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.decoded: Look, a powerful force will rise like a lion from the Jordan River against the strong city, but I will quickly make it flee. Who is worthy to be appointed over her? Who is like me? Who can set the time for me? Who is the shepherd who can stand before me?

verses.kjv: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
verses.decoded: So listen to the LORD’s plan against Edom and His intentions for the people of Teman: even the weakest will lead them away, and their homes will be destroyed along with them.

verses.kjv: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
verses.decoded: The earth shakes at the sound of their downfall; their cries are heard as far away as the Red Sea.

verses.kjv: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.decoded: Look, he will come swiftly like an eagle and spread his wings over Bozrah. On that day, the strong warriors of Edom will be terrified, their hearts trembling like a woman in labor pains.

verses.kjv: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
verses.decoded: About Damascus: Hamath and Arpad are confused and terrified because they have heard bad news. They are weak and shaken; there is distress like waves on the sea that cannot be calmed.

verses.kjv: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
verses.decoded: Damascus has become weak and tries to escape; fear has gripped her. She is filled with pain and sorrow, like a woman in labor.

verses.kjv: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!
verses.decoded: How could the city I praised and delighted in be abandoned?

verses.kjv: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.decoded: Because of this, her young men will die in the streets, and all her soldiers will be destroyed on that day, says the LORD Almighty.

verses.kjv: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.
verses.decoded: I will start a fire in the walls of Damascus that will burn down the palaces of Benhadad.

verses.kjv: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
verses.decoded: About Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon will attack, says the LORD: Get up, go to Kedar, and plunder the people of the east.

verses.kjv: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.
verses.decoded: They will seize their tents and flocks, take their curtains, all their belongings, and their camels. They will shout to them, 'Fear is all around you!'

verses.kjv: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.
verses.decoded: Run away, go far away, live in hiding, people of Hazor, says the LORD, because King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon has planned against you and made a decision to attack you.

verses.kjv: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.
verses.decoded: Get up and go to the rich nation that lives without worry, says the LORD. They have no gates or bars and live all alone.

verses.kjv: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Their camels will be taken as plunder, and their many cattle will be stolen. I will scatter those living in the farthest places in every direction, and I will bring disaster on them from all sides, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.
verses.decoded: Hazor will become a home for wild creatures and a permanent wasteland; no one will live there anymore.

verses.kjv: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
verses.decoded: This is the message from the LORD given to Jeremiah the prophet about Elam, at the start of King Zedekiah’s reign in Judah.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
verses.decoded: The LORD of armies says: I will break Elam’s bow, their main source of strength.

verses.kjv: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
verses.decoded: I will send the four winds from every direction to scatter Elam’s people everywhere; there will be no nation where Elam’s exiles won’t go.

verses.kjv: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith the LORD; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
verses.decoded: I will make Elam afraid before their enemies and those who want to kill them. I will bring disaster on them with my fierce anger, says the LORD, and I will send the sword to destroy them completely.

verses.kjv: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will establish my rule over Elam and destroy their king and leaders, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: But in the future, I will restore Elam’s captivity, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: The word that the LORD spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.decoded: This is the message the LORD gave against Babylon and the land of the Chaldeans through the prophet Jeremiah.

verses.kjv: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
verses.decoded: Announce it to the nations, spread the news, raise a banner; don’t hide it: say, 'Babylon has been captured, Bel is humiliated, Merodach is shattered; her idols are disgraced, her statues are broken.'

verses.kjv: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.
verses.decoded: A nation will come from the north against Babylon, making its land empty and uninhabited; people and animals will leave and never return.

verses.kjv: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.
verses.decoded: At that time, says the LORD, the people of Israel and Judah will come together, weeping as they go, seeking the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.
verses.decoded: They will ask the way to Zion, facing that direction, saying, 'Come, let us make a lasting agreement with the LORD that will never be forgotten.'

verses.kjv: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.
verses.decoded: My people are like lost sheep; their leaders have led them astray, driving them away over the hills and mountains. They have wandered everywhere and forgotten where to rest.

verses.kjv: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.
verses.decoded: Those who found them have destroyed them, and their enemies said, 'We are not wrong to do this because they have sinned against the LORD, the place of justice, the LORD who is the hope of their ancestors.'

verses.kjv: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.
verses.decoded: Leave Babylon and the land of the Chaldeans; go out like the lead goats that guide the flock.

verses.kjv: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.
verses.decoded: I will bring together powerful nations from the north to attack Babylon; they will prepare for battle and capture her. Their arrows will be like those of a skilled warrior; none will miss their target.

verses.kjv: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Chaldea will be plundered, and everyone who takes from her will be fully satisfied, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;
verses.decoded: You were happy and celebrated, you destroyers of my people, because you became prosperous like a well-fed cow and made loud noises like bulls.

verses.kjv: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
verses.decoded: Your mother will be deeply ashamed; the one who gave birth to you will be humiliated. Look, the last of the nations will become a wasteland, dry and deserted.

verses.kjv: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
verses.decoded: Because of the LORD’s anger, Babylon will be uninhabited and completely destroyed. Everyone who passes by will be shocked and mock her suffering.

verses.kjv: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD.
verses.decoded: Surround Babylon and prepare for battle; all archers, shoot at her without holding back, because she has sinned against the LORD.

verses.kjv: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the LORD: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.
verses.decoded: Shout all around Babylon: she has surrendered; her foundations have collapsed, her walls are broken down. This is the LORD’s revenge—punish her as she has punished others.

verses.kjv: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.
verses.decoded: Stop those who plant and harvest in Babylon; because of the threat of the attacking sword, everyone will return to their own people and flee back to their homeland.

verses.kjv: Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.
verses.decoded: Israel is like scattered sheep, driven away by fierce enemies: first the king of Assyria destroyed them, and finally Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, crushed them completely.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, says: I will punish the king of Babylon and his country just as I punished the king of Assyria.

verses.kjv: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.
verses.decoded: I will restore Israel to their own land, where they will enjoy the fertile regions of Carmel and Bashan, and find satisfaction in the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.

verses.kjv: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
verses.decoded: At that time, says the LORD, people will look for Israel’s sins but find none; they will search for Judah’s sins but find none, because I will forgive those I protect.

verses.kjv: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.
verses.decoded: Attack the land of Merathaim and its people in Pekod; destroy them completely, as I have commanded you, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
verses.decoded: There is the noise of battle and widespread destruction throughout the land.

verses.kjv: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!
verses.decoded: How the hammer that struck the whole earth is shattered and broken! Babylon has become a ruin among the nations!

verses.kjv: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD.
verses.decoded: I set a trap for you, Babylon, and you were caught without realizing it; you have been found and captured because you opposed the LORD.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.decoded: The LORD has opened His armory and brought out His weapons of anger; this is the work of the LORD God of Heaven’s Armies against the land of the Chaldeans.

verses.kjv: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
verses.decoded: Attack her from the farthest borders, loot her storehouses, pile her ruins high, and destroy her completely; leave nothing behind.

verses.kjv: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
verses.decoded: Kill all her cattle; send them to the slaughter. Woe to them! Their day of punishment has arrived.

verses.kjv: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.
verses.decoded: The voices of those fleeing Babylon will be heard in Zion, announcing the LORD’s revenge and the punishment of His temple’s enemies.

verses.kjv: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: Gather all archers and surround Babylon; let no one escape. Punish her as she deserves for her proud rebellion against the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Because of this, her young men will die in the streets, and all her soldiers will be destroyed on that day, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.
verses.decoded: Look, I am against you, proud one, says the Lord God of Heaven’s Armies, because your day has come—the time I will punish you.

verses.kjv: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
verses.decoded: The proud will stumble and fall, and no one will help them up. I will set fire to their cities, and it will burn everything around them.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord of Heaven’s Armies says: The people of Israel and Judah were oppressed together, and those who captured them refused to release them.

verses.kjv: Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.decoded: Their Redeemer is powerful—the Lord of Heaven’s Armies is his name. He will defend their cause fully, giving rest to the land and troubling the people of Babylon.

verses.kjv: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.
verses.decoded: The Lord says, a sword is coming against the Chaldeans, the people of Babylon, their leaders, and their wise men.

verses.kjv: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
verses.decoded: A sword is coming against the deceivers, and they will lose their senses; a sword is against the strong warriors, and they will be terrified.

verses.kjv: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.
verses.decoded: A sword will strike their horses, chariots, and all the mixed peoples in their midst; they will become weak like women. A sword is also against their treasures, which will be stolen.

verses.kjv: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.
verses.decoded: A drought will dry up their water sources because this is a land of carved idols, and the people are obsessed with their false gods.

verses.kjv: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
verses.decoded: So wild animals from the desert and islands will live there, and owls will make it their home. It will never be inhabited again, no one will live there from generation to generation.

verses.kjv: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
verses.decoded: Just as God destroyed Sodom, Gomorrah, and nearby cities, no one will live there anymore, says the Lord.

verses.kjv: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.decoded: Look, a people will come from the north—a great nation with many kings will rise from the distant coastlands.

verses.kjv: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.
verses.decoded: They will carry bows and spears; they are ruthless and show no mercy. Their voices will roar like the sea as they ride horses, fully armed for battle against you, daughter of Babylon.

verses.kjv: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.
verses.decoded: The king of Babylon hears the news and his hands grow weak; anguish grips him like a woman in labor pains.

verses.kjv: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.decoded: Look, he will come like a lion from the rising waters of the Jordan to the strong fortress, but I will make them suddenly flee from her. Who is a chosen leader I can appoint over her? Who is like me? Who can set the time? Who is the shepherd who can stand before me?

verses.kjv: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.
verses.decoded: So listen to the Lord’s plan against Babylon and His purpose against the land of the Chaldeans: even the weakest of His people will lead them away, and he will make their home desolate along with them.

verses.kjv: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
verses.decoded: When Babylon is captured, the earth shakes, and people all over the world hear the loud cries.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: I will bring a destructive force against Babylon and those living at its very center who rebel against me.

verses.kjv: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.
verses.decoded: I will send agents to Babylon who will scatter her people and empty her land; when trouble comes, they will surround her from all sides.

verses.kjv: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.
verses.decoded: Let the archer aim at those who prepare for battle and those who proudly wear armor; do not spare her young soldiers—completely destroy her army.

verses.kjv: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.
verses.decoded: Many will be killed in the land of the Chaldeans, and the wounded will lie dead in her streets.

verses.kjv: For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the LORD of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: Israel and Judah have not been abandoned by their God, the LORD of hosts, even though their land was full of sin against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the LORD’s vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
verses.decoded: Escape from Babylon quickly and save your lives; don’t be destroyed because of her sins. This is the LORD’s time for punishment; He will repay her for what she has done.

verses.kjv: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the LORD’s hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
verses.decoded: Babylon was like a golden cup in the LORD’s hand that made the whole world drunk; the nations drank her wine and became crazy.

verses.kjv: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
verses.decoded: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed. Cry out for her and prepare medicine for her wounds, hoping she might recover.

verses.kjv: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
verses.decoded: We tried to help Babylon, but she wouldn’t be healed. Leave her alone and each return to your own land, because her punishment reaches up to heaven and is very severe.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.
verses.decoded: The LORD has revealed our righteousness; come, let us proclaim in Zion the works of the LORD our God.

verses.kjv: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.
verses.decoded: Prepare your arrows and gather your shields; the LORD has stirred up the kings of the Medes to carry out His plan against Babylon to destroy it, because this is the LORD’s revenge for His temple.

verses.kjv: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.decoded: Raise the battle flag on Babylon’s walls, strengthen the guards, station watchmen, and prepare ambushes, because the LORD has planned and carried out what He promised against Babylon’s people.

verses.kjv: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.
verses.decoded: You who live by many waters and have great wealth, your time has come; your greed has reached its limit.

verses.kjv: The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.
verses.decoded: The LORD of hosts has sworn by Himself: I will fill you with soldiers like caterpillars, and they will shout loudly against you.

verses.kjv: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
verses.decoded: He created the earth by His power, established the world by His wisdom, and spread out the heavens by His understanding.

verses.kjv: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.decoded: When God speaks, the skies roar like a vast ocean; He causes clouds to rise from the farthest parts of the earth. He creates lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from His storehouses.

verses.kjv: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.decoded: People are foolish because of what they think they know; every craftsman is confused by the idols they make, because their molten images are lies and have no life in them.

verses.kjv: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.decoded: These idols are worthless, made by mistake; when judgment comes, they will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts is his name.
verses.decoded: God’s chosen people, Jacob’s descendants, are different because He created everything. Israel is the symbol of His inheritance, and the LORD Almighty is His name.

verses.kjv: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;
verses.decoded: You are my weapon of war; through you I will smash nations and destroy kingdoms.

verses.kjv: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
verses.decoded: With you, I will shatter both horse and rider, and break the chariot and its driver.

verses.kjv: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;
verses.decoded: With you, I will destroy men and women, old and young, young men and young women alike.

verses.kjv: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
verses.decoded: I will also destroy shepherds and their sheep, farmers and their oxen, as well as commanders and leaders—all through you.

verses.kjv: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will repay Babylon and all the people of Chaldea for the evil they have done in Zion, right before your eyes, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.
verses.decoded: Look, I am against you, O destructive mountain, says the LORD, who destroys the whole earth. I will reach out my hand against you, roll you down from the rocks, and turn you into a burning ruin.

verses.kjv: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: No one will take a stone from you for a cornerstone or foundation; you will be desolate forever, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
verses.decoded: Raise a flag in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, get them ready against her. Call the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz to gather against her; appoint a commander and bring horses like swarming locusts.

verses.kjv: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
verses.decoded: Get the nations ready against her, including the kings of the Medes, their commanders, all their leaders, and all the land under their control.

verses.kjv: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the LORD shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.decoded: The land will shake and mourn because every plan of the LORD will be carried out against Babylon, making it a deserted wasteland with no people living there.

verses.kjv: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.
verses.decoded: Babylon’s warriors have refused to fight and stayed inside their strongholds. Their strength has failed; they have become weak like women. Their homes have been burned, and their gates are broken down.

verses.kjv: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,
verses.decoded: One courier will run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to tell the king of Babylon that his city has been captured on one side.

verses.kjv: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
verses.decoded: They will report that the escape routes are blocked, the reed beds have been set on fire, and the soldiers are terrified.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Babylon is like a threshing floor; the time to thresh her has come. Soon, her harvest will be ready.

verses.kjv: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.
verses.decoded: Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, has destroyed me; he crushed me, emptied me like a broken jar, swallowed me like a dragon, filled himself with my wealth, and then threw me away.

verses.kjv: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.
verses.decoded: The people of Zion will say, 'Let Babylon bear the violence done to me and my body.' Jerusalem will say, 'Let the blood I shed be on the people of Chaldea.'

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.
verses.decoded: So the LORD says: I will defend your cause and take revenge for you. I will dry up Babylon’s sea and make her springs run dry.

verses.kjv: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
verses.decoded: Babylon will become ruins, a home for wild creatures, a place of horror and scorn, with no one living there.

verses.kjv: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions’ whelps.
verses.decoded: Wild animals will roar together like lions; they will cry out like lion cubs.

verses.kjv: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: I will bring their celebrations to an end; I will make them drunk so they will rejoice and then fall into a deep, eternal sleep without waking, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
verses.decoded: I will lead them like lambs to be slaughtered, like rams and goats being sacrificed.

verses.kjv: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
verses.decoded: How has Sheshach (Babylon) been captured! The pride of the whole world is shocked! Babylon has become a horror among the nations!

verses.kjv: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
verses.decoded: The sea has risen over Babylon; waves have overwhelmed her completely.

verses.kjv: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.
verses.decoded: Her cities lie in ruins, dry and deserted, a wasteland where no one lives or even passes through.

verses.kjv: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
verses.decoded: I will punish Bel (a Babylonian god) in Babylon and force him to release what he has swallowed. Nations will no longer gather to him, and Babylon’s walls will collapse.

verses.kjv: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.decoded: My people, come out from Babylon and save yourselves from the LORD’s fierce anger.

verses.kjv: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
verses.decoded: Don’t lose heart or be afraid because of the news you hear in the land; there will be rumors one year, and then more rumors the next year, along with violence—leaders fighting against leaders.

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
verses.decoded: Look, the time is coming when I will bring judgment on Babylon’s idols; her whole land will be confused and destroyed, and many will die right in her own territory.

verses.kjv: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Then the sky, the earth, and everything in them will celebrate Babylon’s downfall, because invaders will come to her from the north, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.
verses.decoded: Just as Babylon caused many Israelites to be killed, so Babylon itself will suffer the deaths of people from all over the earth.

verses.kjv: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
verses.decoded: If you have escaped the sword, flee quickly and don’t stay; remember the LORD from a distance and think about Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD’s house.
verses.decoded: We are confused and ashamed because we’ve heard insults; strangers have entered the LORD’s holy places.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
verses.decoded: Therefore, the LORD says, the time is coming when I will punish her idols, and throughout her land the injured will cry out in pain.

verses.kjv: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD.
verses.decoded: Even if Babylon tries to reach the heavens or build strong defenses, I will send invaders against her, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
verses.decoded: A cry of alarm comes from Babylon, announcing great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans.

verses.kjv: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
verses.decoded: Because the LORD has ruined Babylon and silenced her proud voice, when her people cry out like roaring waves, their noise is heard.

verses.kjv: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.
verses.decoded: Because invaders have attacked Babylon, capturing her warriors and breaking all their weapons; the LORD, the God who repays, will surely punish her.

verses.kjv: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
verses.decoded: I will cause her princes, wise men, commanders, rulers, and warriors to become drunk and fall into an eternal sleep—they will never wake up, says the LORD Almighty.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.
verses.decoded: The LORD Almighty says: Babylon’s wide walls will be completely destroyed, her tall gates burned with fire; the people will work hard but achieve nothing, and those in the fire will grow tired.

verses.kjv: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.
verses.decoded: This is the message Jeremiah the prophet gave to Seraiah son of Neriah, son of Maaseiah, when he went to Babylon with King Zedekiah of Judah in the fourth year of his reign. Seraiah was a respected official.

verses.kjv: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.
verses.decoded: Jeremiah wrote down in a book all the disasters that would come upon Babylon—all these words written against her.

verses.kjv: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;
verses.decoded: Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When you arrive in Babylon and see and read all these words,

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou say, O LORD, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
verses.decoded: You will then say, 'O LORD, you have declared judgment against this place, to destroy it completely so that no people or animals will remain, and it will be empty forever.'

verses.kjv: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
verses.decoded: After you finish reading this scroll, tie a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates River,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
verses.decoded: and say, 'This is how Babylon will sink and never recover from the disaster I will bring on her; her people will be exhausted.' These are the words of Jeremiah.

verses.kjv: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.decoded: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he ruled in Jerusalem for eleven years. His mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.decoded: He did evil in the sight of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done before him.

verses.kjv: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.decoded: Because of the LORD’s anger, it happened in Jerusalem and Judah that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon, who had taken them away from His presence.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.
verses.decoded: In the ninth year of Zedekiah’s reign, on the tenth day of the tenth month, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon and his entire army came to Jerusalem, camped there, and built siege works all around the city.

verses.kjv: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.decoded: The city was under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

verses.kjv: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.decoded: By the ninth day of the fourth month, there was a severe famine in the city; the people had no bread to eat.

verses.kjv: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.
verses.decoded: Then the city walls were broken through, and all the soldiers fled at night through the gate between the two walls near the king’s garden. The Babylonians were surrounding the city, so they escaped by way of the plain.

verses.kjv: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
verses.decoded: But the Babylonian army chased after the king and caught Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. His entire army was scattered and fled from him.

verses.kjv: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.
verses.decoded: They captured the king and brought him to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where the king passed judgment on him.

verses.kjv: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
verses.decoded: The king of Babylon killed Zedekiah’s sons in front of him, and also executed all the princes of Judah at Riblah.

verses.kjv: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
verses.decoded: Then the king of Babylon blinded Zedekiah, bound him with chains, and took him to Babylon where he was imprisoned until he died.

verses.kjv: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,
verses.decoded: In the fifth month, on the tenth day, in the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard serving the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And burned the house of the LORD, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:
verses.decoded: He burned the LORD’s temple, the king’s palace, all the houses in Jerusalem, and the homes of the important people with fire.

verses.kjv: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.decoded: The entire Babylonian army with the captain of the guard tore down all the walls surrounding Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.
verses.decoded: Then Nebuzaradan took captive some of the poor people left in the city, along with the rest of the survivors and those who had surrendered to the king of Babylon, as well as the remaining crowd.

verses.kjv: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.
verses.decoded: But Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, left some of the poor people in the land to work as vineyard workers and farmers.

verses.kjv: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.
verses.decoded: The Chaldeans broke the bronze pillars, the bases, and the large bronze basin in the temple of the LORD, and took all the bronze to Babylon.

verses.kjv: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
verses.decoded: They also took away the bronze pots, shovels (tools for removing ashes), snuffers, bowls, spoons, and all the bronze utensils used in the temple service.

verses.kjv: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.
verses.decoded: The captain of the guard also took the basins, firepans (censers), bowls, pots, lampstands, spoons, and cups—everything made of gold or silver.

verses.kjv: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
verses.decoded: The two pillars, the large basin called the 'sea,' and the twelve bronze bulls under the bases—all made by King Solomon for the temple—were made of bronze without any exact weight measurement.

verses.kjv: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.
verses.decoded: One of the pillars was eighteen cubits tall, with a decorative band twelve cubits around it; it was four fingers thick and hollow inside.

verses.kjv: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.
verses.decoded: A bronze capital five cubits high sat on top, decorated with a bronze lattice and pomegranates all around. The second pillar and its decorations were the same.

verses.kjv: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.
verses.decoded: There were ninety-six pomegranates on each side, and a total of one hundred pomegranates around the entire latticework.

verses.kjv: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
verses.decoded: The captain of the guard arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three gatekeepers.

verses.kjv: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king’s person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.
verses.decoded: He also took from the city an eunuch who was in charge of the soldiers, seven men who served close to the king, the chief military scribe who organized the people, and sixty common people found in the city.

verses.kjv: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
verses.decoded: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

verses.kjv: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.
verses.decoded: The king of Babylon executed them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. This marked the exile of Judah from their own land.

verses.kjv: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:
verses.decoded: These are the people Nebuchadnezzar took captive: in the seventh year, 3,023 Jews.

verses.kjv: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:
verses.decoded: In Nebuchadnezzar’s eighteenth year, he took 832 people captive from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.
verses.decoded: In Nebuchadnezzar’s twenty-third year, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the guard, took 745 Jews captive. Altogether, there were 4,600 people taken.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,
verses.decoded: In the thirty-seventh year of Jehoiachin king of Judah's captivity, in the twelfth month on the twenty-fifth day, Evil-merodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, raised Jehoiachin's status and released him from prison.

verses.kjv: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,
verses.decoded: He treated Jehoiachin kindly and gave him a position of honor higher than the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

verses.kjv: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.
verses.decoded: His prison clothes were replaced, and he was given food regularly in the king’s presence for the rest of his life.

verses.kjv: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
verses.decoded: The king of Babylon provided Jehoiachin with a daily food allowance for the rest of his life, until he died.
